department: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
text: FSSAI Food Business Registration & License: Mandatory registration or state license for food manufacturers, restaurants, bakeries, cloud kitchens, and street food operators. Estimated 7–15 working days. Government fee: ₹100 (Registration) – ₹2,000 (State License).

department: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
text: Determine eligibility category. Check annual turnover: under ₹12 Lakh requires basic Registration; between ₹12 Lakh and ₹20 Crore requires a State License. Required documents: Turnover statement, Business identity proof. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
text: Create account on FoSCoS portal. Register on the Food Safety Compliance System (FoSCoS) using valid mobile number and email ID. Required documents: Aadhaar card, PAN card of business/proprietor. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

department: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
section_title: Complete Form A or Form B
text: Complete Form A or Form B. Fill in premises address, nature of food business, proposed list of food categories to be handled, and equipment details. Required documents: Premises proof (Electricity bill/Rent agreement). Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
text: Upload food safety declarations. Submit standard food safety management system (FSMS) plan, water test report, and food handler medical fitness certificate. Required documents: FSMS declaration, Water testing lab report, Medical fitness certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1–2 days.

department: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
text: Pay license fee online. Pay government prescribed fee through online payment gateway (UPI/Net banking/Card). Required documents: Payment receipt. Fee: ₹100 – ₹2,000. Processing time: Immediate.

department: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
text: Food safety officer inspection. For state licenses, a Food Safety Officer conducts premise verification for hygiene standards. Required documents: Original document copies. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3–7 working days.

department: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
text: Download FSSAI license certificate. Upon verification approval, download the 14-digit FSSAI registration certificate with QR code. Required documents: Application reference number. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

Shops & Commercial Establishments Registration (Gumasta): Legal registration required for commercial offices, retail shops, and service establishments employing workers. Estimated 3–5 working days. Government fee: ₹250 – ₹1,500 depending on employee count.
Register on state labour portal. Create profile on state unified labour/single-window clearance portal with business details. Required documents: Aadhaar, PAN. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

Fill application form. Enter establishment name, full postal address, category of business, number of male/female employees, and working hours. Required documents: Rent agreement or property tax receipt. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Upload identity and address proofs. Attach photo of proprietor with shop signboard displaying name clearly in regional language & English. Required documents: Signboard photograph, Electricity bill. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.
Pay statutory registration fees. Submit fee calculated based on employee bracket via integrated portal gateway. Required documents: Challan receipt. Fee: ₹250 – ₹1,500. Processing time: Immediate.

Download digital certificate. Receive digitally signed Shops & Establishment Certificate without physical inspection for low-risk units. Required documents: Application reference. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 working days.

Commercial Fire Safety NOC: Mandatory clearance certifying fire safety preparedness for commercial premises, restaurants, hotels, and event spaces. Estimated 15–21 working days. Government fee: ₹1,000 – ₹5,000 based on floor area.

Install approved fire fighting apparatus. Equip premises with certified ABC fire extinguishers, smoke detectors, emergency exit signage, and hose reels. Required documents: Equipment purchase receipts, Layout diagram. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 2–4 days.

Submit online NOC application. Log in to municipal portal and provide building approval number, occupant capacity, and hazardous material disclosures. Required documents: Architectural floor plan, Building sanction plan. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Schedule site inspection. Fire station officer will schedule an on-site audit of egress routes, fire alarms, and extinguisher validity. Required documents: Inspection checklist. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7–10 working days.

Rectify compliance observations. If discrepancies are noted during inspection, complete compliance actions within 15 calendar days. Required documents: Compliance report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3–5 days.

Issuance of Fire Safety Certificate. Download renewable 1-year Fire Safety Certificate from municipal portal. Required documents: Fire NOC certificate. Fee: ₹1,000 – ₹5,000. Processing time: 2 working days.

Commercial Signboard & Outdoor Advertisement Permission: Official permit to erect commercial display boards, neon signs, hoardings, or rooftop advertisement structures. Estimated 7–10 working days. Government fee: ₹500 application fee + ₹50/sq.ft annual tax.

Measure signboard dimensions. Calculate exact display area (length x height) and ensure adherence to city standard building bylaws. Required documents: Dimension drawings, Color mockup photograph. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Submit online request. Submit premises ownership proof, commercial trade license number, and structural stability certificate for large hoardings. Required documents: Trade license copy, Structural engineer certificate. Fee: ₹500. Processing time: 1 day.

Zonal officer inspection. Municipal field inspector verifies that the sign does not obstruct traffic view, electrical lines, or pedestrians. Required documents: Site verification log. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3–5 days.
Payment of advertisement tax. Pay annual ground rent/advertisement tax calculated based on square footage. Required documents: Tax assessment order. Fee: ₹500 – ₹5,000. Processing time: Immediate.
Receive permission letter. Obtain official permit sticker and permit order valid for 1 financial year. Required documents: Permission letter. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Street Vendor Vending Certificate & ID Card
text: Street Vendor Vending Certificate & ID Card: Registration under Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) Act for hawkers and cart operators. Estimated 14–21 working days. Government fee: ₹0 application + ₹150–₹500 monthly vending fee.

procedure_name: Street Vendor Vending Certificate & ID Card
text: Participation in Town Vending Survey. Verify inclusion in municipal biometric street vendor survey list or apply during quarterly open enrollment. Required documents: Aadhaar card, Voter ID. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Street Vendor Vending Certificate & ID Card
text: Application for vending zone. Submit preference for designated vending zones (stationary, mobile, or weekly market). Required documents: Passport photographs, Bank passbook. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Street Vendor Vending Certificate & ID Card
text: Verification by Town Vending Committee (TVC). TVC reviews applicant credentials and conducts non-overlap verification. Required documents: Vending verification form. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7–10 days.

procedure_name: Street Vendor Vending Certificate & ID Card
text: Allotment of designated vending spot. Receive allotment letter with mapped geo-coordinates within designated vending zone. Required documents: Allotment order. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

procedure_name: Street Vendor Vending Certificate & ID Card
text: Issuance of Smart Vending Card. Collect smart card containing QR code, photo, and permitted trade hours. Required documents: Vending smart card. Fee: ₹150. Processing time: 2 days.

Factory License under Factories Act 1948: Mandatory licensing for industrial premises employing 10+ workers with power or 20+ workers without power. Estimated 20–30 working days. Government fee: ₹1,500 – ₹10,000 based on horsepower & headcount.

Site and building plan approval. Submit manufacturing flowcharts, machinery layout, and ventilation plans for pre-construction clearance. Required documents: Plant layout blueprint, Process flow diagram. Fee: ₹1,000. Processing time: 10 days.

Pollution control consent (CTE). Obtain Consent to Establish from State Pollution Control Board before factory operation. Required documents: PCB CTE certificate. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 15 days.

Submit Form 2 application. Fill online application providing details of installed horsepower, worker capacity, and welfare facilities. Required documents: List of machinery, Safety officer appointment. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Inspectorate on-site audit. Factory inspector conducts safety audit verifying guards on machinery, sanitation, and first aid provisions. Required documents: Compliance inspection report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7 days.
Grant of Factory License. Obtain Factory License valid for 1 to 5 years with annual renewal option. Required documents: Factory license document. Fee: ₹1,500 – ₹10,000. Processing time: 3 days.

Contract Labour Principal Employer Registration: Mandatory registration for employers engaging 20 or more contract workers on any single day. Estimated 7–14 working days. Government fee: ₹500 – ₹2,500.
Prepare Form I statement. Compile contractor agreements, maximum headcounts per contractor, and project duration. Required documents: Contractor service agreements. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

Online registration on Shram Suvidha. Submit LIN (Labour Identification Number) and register establishment details. Required documents: PAN, Certificate of incorporation. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.
Fee payment based on headcount. Pay fee scale according to total maximum contract workers employed. Required documents: Treasury challan. Fee: ₹500 – ₹2,500. Processing time: Immediate.

Review by Assistant Labour Commissioner. Department examines application for wage protection guarantees and statutory compliance. Required documents: Application verification. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5–7 days.
Issuance of Form II Registration. Download certificate of registration as Principal Employer. Required documents: Form II Certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
text: MSME Udyam Registration Certificate: Free official central government registration conferring priority lending, tax exemptions, and government tender benefits. Estimated 1–2 working days. Government fee: ₹0 (Completely Free of Cost).

department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
text: Aadhaar OTP authentication. Enter entrepreneur's 12-digit Aadhaar number and verify via mobile OTP on official Udyam portal. Required documents: Aadhaar number, Active linked mobile. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
text: PAN verification. Enter business PAN card; system automatically fetches tax & turnover data from income tax database. Required documents: PAN card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
text: Fill enterprise particulars. Specify industry category (Manufacturing/Service), NIC 2/4/5-digit codes, and plant address. Required documents: Bank account IFSC & number. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 minutes.

department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
text: Declare employment and investment. Enter total employees and plant/machinery investment value (excluding land & building). Required documents: Self-declaration. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 minutes.

department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
text: Generate Udyam Registration Certificate. System generates permanent digital certificate with lifetime validity and dynamic verification QR code. Required documents: Udyam certificate PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

Legal Metrology Packaged Commodities (LMPC) Registration: Mandatory license for manufacturers, packers, and importers of pre-packaged goods sold to retail consumers. Estimated 10–15 working days. Government fee: ₹500 government fee.
jurisdiction: Central / State Department of Consumer Affairs

text: Review mandatory label declarations. Ensure product packaging specifies manufacturer name, net weight, MRP, date of packaging, and customer care details. Required documents: Sample packaging artwork, Product specification sheet. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.
jurisdiction: Central / State Department of Consumer Affairs

text: Submit Rule 27 application. Apply online on Legal Metrology portal submitting business registration and manufacturing unit location. Required documents: GST registration, Premises lease. Fee: ₹500. Processing time: 1 day.
jurisdiction: Central / State Department of Consumer Affairs

text: Sample verification. Legal Metrology inspector verifies declarations against standard metric units (g, kg, ml, l). Required documents: Packaged sample. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5–7 days.
jurisdiction: Central / State Department of Consumer Affairs

text: Certificate grant. Receive manufacturer/packer registration certificate with official registration number. Required documents: LMPC Certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.
jurisdiction: Central / State Department of Consumer Affairs

text: Health Trade License (Restaurants, Cafes & Bakeries): Public health clearance certifying water quality, pest control, waste disposal, and hygiene standards for eateries. Estimated 10–14 working days. Government fee: ₹1,500 – ₹5,000 depending on seating capacity.

section_title: Arrange water test & pest control contracts
text: Arrange water test & pest control contracts. Obtain potable water laboratory test certificate and quarterly pest control vendor agreement. Required documents: Water bacteriological report, Pest control contract. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 3 days.

Submit premises kitchen plan. Upload blueprint showing cooking area, grease traps, cold storage, handwash stations, and waste segregation bins. Required documents: Kitchen layout map. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Health officer kitchen inspection. Medical Officer of Health (MOH) conducts surprise inspection of food storage, drainage, and staff hygiene. Required documents: Inspection remarks. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 working days.
Pay health license fee. Remit municipal fee online upon satisfaction of inspection report. Required documents: Payment confirmation. Fee: ₹1,500 – ₹5,000. Processing time: Immediate.
Download Health Trade License. Obtain certificate to be visibly displayed at restaurant cashier counter. Required documents: Health Trade License. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Trade Union Registration under Trade Unions Act
text: Trade Union Registration under Trade Unions Act: Registration conferring statutory legal status and collective bargaining rights to representative worker associations. Estimated 30–45 working days. Government fee: ₹100 treasury fee.

procedure_name: Trade Union Registration under Trade Unions Act
text: Adopt constitution & bylaws. Draft constitution containing union objectives, membership fees, executive committee rules, and election intervals. Required documents: Signed constitution document, Meeting resolution minutes. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

procedure_name: Trade Union Registration under Trade Unions Act
text: Gather minimum 7 subscribing members. Ensure minimum 10% or 100 workers (whichever is less) are enrolled as active members. Required documents: Member subscription register. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Trade Union Registration under Trade Unions Act
text: Submit Form A application. Submit application to Registrar of Trade Unions with details of office-bearers, addresses, and parent establishment. Required documents: Form A, Office bearer list. Fee: ₹100. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Trade Union Registration under Trade Unions Act
text: Verification of member consent. Labour officer verifies signatures and confirms absence of duplicate competing union registrations. Required documents: Scrutiny report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 20 days.

procedure_name: Trade Union Registration under Trade Unions Act
text: Issuance of Registration Certificate. Receive Certificate of Registration in Form B with permanent registration number. Required documents: Form B Certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7 days.

Industrial Boiler Registration & Renewal: Statutory steam boiler commissioning and annual pressure testing certification under Indian Boilers Act. Estimated 15–20 working days. Government fee: ₹2,000 – ₹15,000 based on heating surface area.

Submit manufacturer dossier. Upload Form II, III & IV manufacturer material test reports, welder certificates, and hydraulic test certificate. Required documents: Form II/III/IV certificates, Piping isometric drawings. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

Steam pipeline erection check. Approved boiler inspector visits premises to inspect safety valves, water gauges, and steam pipeline alignment. Required documents: Erection audit form. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

Hydraulic pressure testing. Conduct hydrostatic pressure test at 1.5 times the maximum allowable working pressure witnessed by the inspector. Required documents: Hydraulic test log. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Steam test & safety valve setting. Verify safety valves pop open at calibrated working pressure without pressure surge. Required documents: Safety valve calibration certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.
Grant of Boiler Certificate. Receive Form VI certificate authorizing steam generation for 12 months. Required documents: Form VI Boiler Book. Fee: ₹2,000 – ₹15,000. Processing time: 3 days.

Cinema Hall & Multiplex Exhibition License: Mandatory operating license for public cinema theatres, multiplexes, and open-air movie projection venues. Estimated 30–45 working days. Government fee: ₹5,000 – ₹20,000 annual license fee.

Obtain multi-department NOCs. Acquire clearances from Electrical Inspector, PWD Structural, Fire Safety Department, and Municipal Health. Required documents: PWD stability certificate, Fire NOC, Electrical safety certificate. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 15 days.

Submit Form B application. Apply to District Magistrate submitting cinema hall layout, seating capacity, exit pathways, and air-conditioning plans. Required documents: Building plans, Ownership documents. Fee: ₹1,000. Processing time: 2 days.

Joint multi-agency inspection. Magisterial committee inspects auditorium acoustics, fire suppression, emergency lighting, and parking facilities. Required documents: Joint inspection minutes. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 days.
Pay annual license fee. Remit state entertainment tax / cinematography license fee at government treasury. Required documents: Treasury receipt. Fee: ₹5,000 – ₹20,000. Processing time: Immediate.
Issuance of Form C License. District Magistrate issues official operating license specifying approved seating count. Required documents: Form C Cinema License. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

procedure_name: Temporary Event Liquor Serving Permit (L-50 / P-10)
text: Temporary Event Liquor Serving Permit (L-50 / P-10): Single-day permission to serve alcoholic beverages at private parties, banquets, and commercial corporate events. Estimated 2–3 working days. Government fee: ₹2,500 – ₹10,000 per day based on venue capacity.

procedure_name: Temporary Event Liquor Serving Permit (L-50 / P-10)
section_title: Book approved banquet or private venue
text: Book approved banquet or private venue. Confirm venue reservation and acquire venue owner's letter of permission. Required documents: Venue booking receipt, Owner consent letter. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Temporary Event Liquor Serving Permit (L-50 / P-10)
text: Submit online permit application. Enter event host details, guest count estimate, event date/hours, and liquor source retailer name. Required documents: Host Aadhaar & PAN, Invitation card copy. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Temporary Event Liquor Serving Permit (L-50 / P-10)
text: Pay permit duty online. Remit daily event excise duty through state integrated financial management portal. Required documents: Challan receipt. Fee: ₹2,500 – ₹10,000. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: Temporary Event Liquor Serving Permit (L-50 / P-10)
text: Procure liquor from authorized retailer. Purchase beverages exclusively from authorized state vends accompanied by serial-numbered invoices. Required documents: Authorized excise bill. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Temporary Event Liquor Serving Permit (L-50 / P-10)
text: Display permit at bar counter. Keep physical/digital copy of issued excise permit at the serving bar during the entire event. Required documents: Official permit pass. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: Pet Shop & Dog Breeding Establishment License
department: State Animal Welfare Board (SAWB) & Municipal Corporation
text: Pet Shop & Dog Breeding Establishment License: Mandatory license under Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Pet Shop & Dog Breeding) Rules. Estimated 21–30 working days. Government fee: ₹5,000 registration fee.

procedure_name: Pet Shop & Dog Breeding Establishment License
department: State Animal Welfare Board (SAWB) & Municipal Corporation
text: Facility standard compliance. Ensure adequate enclosure dimensions, temperature regulation, quarantine cages, and sanitary ventilation. Required documents: Facility layout diagram, Veterinary care tie-up agreement. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 3 days.

procedure_name: Pet Shop & Dog Breeding Establishment License
department: State Animal Welfare Board (SAWB) & Municipal Corporation
section_title: Submit Form I to State Animal Welfare Board
text: Submit Form I to State Animal Welfare Board. Apply online with photographs of housing pens, grooming areas, and waste disposal mechanisms. Required documents: Aadhaar, Veterinarian consent letter. Fee: ₹5,000. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Pet Shop & Dog Breeding Establishment License
department: State Animal Welfare Board (SAWB) & Municipal Corporation
text: Veterinary inspection committee. Authorized veterinary officer inspects animal welfare protocols, microchipping, and vaccination logs. Required documents: Inspection audit sheet. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 14 days.

procedure_name: Pet Shop & Dog Breeding Establishment License
department: State Animal Welfare Board (SAWB) & Municipal Corporation
text: Certificate grant. Receive Animal Welfare Board registration certificate valid for 2 calendar years. Required documents: Pet shop registration certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

Commercial Weighing Scale Verification & Stamping: Mandatory annual calibration and lead-sealing of electronic and mechanical balances used in trade. Estimated 2–4 working days. Government fee: ₹150 – ₹800 based on scale capacity.

Purchase model-approved scale. Verify that the machine holds a Government of India Model Approval Certificate. Required documents: Model approval certificate, Invoice. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 1 day.

Schedule verification test. Take scale to local Legal Metrology laboratory or request on-site inspection for heavy weighbridges. Required documents: Application form, Previous stamping card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Standard mass calibration test. Inspector tests zero error, corner load error, and sensitivity using certified standard weights. Required documents: Test observations. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 hour.

Lead seal stamping. Inspector fixes tamper-evident lead security seal and affixes the current year/quarter stamp. Required documents: Stamping stamp mark. Fee: ₹150 – ₹800. Processing time: Immediate.

Issuance of Verification Certificate. Receive Certificate of Verification to be kept available for surprise consumer checks. Required documents: Verification certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

Clinical Establishment Registration (Clinics & Diagnostic Labs): Statutory registration under Clinical Establishments (Registration and Regulation) Act. Estimated 20–30 working days. Government fee: ₹1,000 – ₹5,000 based on beds & services.

Verify doctor qualifications. Compile medical council registrations (NMC/DCI) for all practicing clinicians and technicians. Required documents: Medical registration certificates, Doctor degrees. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.
Bio-medical waste agreement. Execute formal contract with authorized Common Bio-medical Waste Treatment Facility (CBWTF). Required documents: BMW agreement copy. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 2 days.

Online Form A submission. Enter clinic carpet area, emergency equipment list, staff roster, and tariff transparency board. Required documents: Form A, Premises lease. Fee: ₹1,000 – ₹5,000. Processing time: 1 day.
Civil Surgeon audit. District inspection committee inspects sterilization autoclaves, drug storage, and waste color bins. Required documents: Audit report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10–14 days.

Issuance of Provisional/Permanent Certificate. Receive certificate of registration valid for display in the reception lobby. Required documents: Clinical Establishment Certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

Electricity Load Enhancement / Reduction: Procedure to increase or decrease sanctioned electrical connected load for residential and commercial premises. Estimated 7–10 working days. Government fee: ₹300 – ₹1,500 security deposit per kW enhanced.
Calculate total connected wattage. Add wattage of new air-conditioners, motors, and appliances to determine required kW. Required documents: List of appliances. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Submit application on DISCOM portal. Enter consumer CA number, current sanctioned load, requested load, and upload latest paid electricity bill. Required documents: Latest paid electricity bill, Ownership proof/Lease. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Wiring test certificate submission. For load enhancements exceeding 5 kW, submit wiring test report signed by a licensed electrical contractor. Required documents: Licensed contractor test report. Fee: ₹250. Processing time: 2 days.

Pay security & service charges. Pay revised security deposit and meter upgrade fee via integrated net banking or bill desk. Required documents: Payment receipt. Fee: ₹300 – ₹1,500 / kW. Processing time: Immediate.

Meter replacement or breaker recalibration. DISCOM linesman installs appropriate CT meter or adjusts MCB rating at property. Required documents: Work completion certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3–5 days.

department: Public Health & Engineering Department / Municipal Corporation
text: New Underground Sewerage Connection: Sanction to connect household drainage pipe to municipal underground sewer mains. Estimated 10–15 working days. Government fee: ₹1,200 – ₹3,500 connection & road cutting fee.

department: Public Health & Engineering Department / Municipal Corporation
text: Prepare internal plumbing blueprint. Plumbing map showing inspection chambers, slope gradients, and gully trap locations. Required documents: Plumber layout plan. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

department: Public Health & Engineering Department / Municipal Corporation
text: Submit municipal application. Submit building sanction letter, water connection receipt, and road cutting permission request. Required documents: Water connection bill, Building completion copy. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Public Health & Engineering Department / Municipal Corporation
text: Junior Engineer field inspection. JE measures distance from property boundary to sewer manhole and estimates road restoration fee. Required documents: JE site measurement. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

department: Public Health & Engineering Department / Municipal Corporation
text: Payment of road restoration charges. Pay connection fee and road restoration deposit at municipal citizen service counter. Required documents: Municipal receipt. Fee: ₹1,200 – ₹3,500. Processing time: Immediate.

department: Public Health & Engineering Department / Municipal Corporation
text: Supervised connection & sealing. Licensed plumber executes pipeline hookup to municipal manhole under junior engineer supervision. Required documents: Connection completion memo. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

department: State Nodal Renewable Energy Agency & DISCOM
text: Rooftop Solar Net Metering Connection: Interconnection approval and bidirectional solar meter installation under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana. Estimated 20–30 working days. Government fee: ₹1,000 application fee (Subsidies up to ₹78,000 available).

department: State Nodal Renewable Energy Agency & DISCOM
text: Register on National Solar Portal. Apply on PM Surya Ghar portal selecting DISCOM, consumer account number, and proposed solar kW capacity. Required documents: Electricity bill, Aadhaar. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

department: State Nodal Renewable Energy Agency & DISCOM
text: Technical feasibility approval (TFR). DISCOM checks distribution transformer capacity and issues technical clearance within 10 days. Required documents: TFR Approval letter. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7–10 days.

department: State Nodal Renewable Energy Agency & DISCOM
text: Installation by empanelled vendor. Empanelled solar contractor installs ALMM-approved solar panels, grid-tied inverter, and earthing. Required documents: Plant commissioning document, Vendor invoice. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 5–7 days.

department: State Nodal Renewable Energy Agency & DISCOM
text: Net meter inspection and testing. DISCOM inspects anti-islanding protection and installs bidirectional import-export net meter. Required documents: Net meter test report. Fee: ₹1,000. Processing time: 5 days.

department: State Nodal Renewable Energy Agency & DISCOM
text: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) subsidy. DISCOM submits commissioning report; central subsidy credited directly to citizen's bank account within 30 days. Required documents: Bank passbook copy. Fee: Subsidy credit. Processing time: 30 days.

department: City Gas Distribution Utility (e.g. IGL / GAIL Gas)
text: Domestic Piped Natural Gas (PNG) Connection: Piped natural gas pipeline installation for domestic cooking and water geysers. Estimated 10–14 working days. Government fee: ₹5,000 – ₹7,000 (Refundable security deposit).

department: City Gas Distribution Utility (e.g. IGL / GAIL Gas)
text: Check pipeline network availability. Verify whether gas pipeline riser has been laid in your residential lane or apartment tower. Required documents: Address proof. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

department: City Gas Distribution Utility (e.g. IGL / GAIL Gas)
text: Submit online connection request. Submit ownership proof or NOC from landlord along with identity details. Required documents: Rent agreement / Sale deed, PAN / Aadhaar. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: City Gas Distribution Utility (e.g. IGL / GAIL Gas)
text: Pay refundable connection deposit. Pay security deposit online or opt for installments integrated into bimonthly gas bills. Required documents: Payment receipt. Fee: ₹5,000 – ₹7,000. Processing time: Immediate.

department: City Gas Distribution Utility (e.g. IGL / GAIL Gas)
text: Internal kitchen piping installation. Utility technician installs yellow GI pipeline, copper tubing, gas isolation valve, and digital meter. Required documents: Installation safety certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3–5 days.

department: City Gas Distribution Utility (e.g. IGL / GAIL Gas)
text: Stove conversion and gas commissioning. Technician adjusts stove nozzle from LPG to PNG and commissions gas flow safely. Required documents: Commissioning slip. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Construction & Demolition (C&D) Debris Removal: On-demand municipal collection service for bulk concrete, brick, and renovation debris to prevent illegal dumping. Estimated 2–4 working days. Government fee: ₹500 – ₹1,500 per tractor trolley load.
Estimate debris quantity. Assess approximate volume of renovation debris in metric tons or trolley loads. Required documents: Photographs of debris heap. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

section_title: Book pickup on municipal helpline / portal
text: Book pickup on municipal helpline / portal. Register booking on municipal app or citizen helpline providing pickup address. Required documents: Aadhaar, Contact mobile. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.
Pay lifting charges. Pay prescribed lifting and processing charges online. Required documents: Challan payment. Fee: ₹500 – ₹1,500 / load. Processing time: Immediate.

Designated dumping pickup. Municipal hydraulic tipper arrives at site, loads waste, and transports it to recycling facility. Required documents: Waste handover slip. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 working days.

procedure_name: Testing and Replacement of Faulty Water Meter
text: Testing and Replacement of Faulty Water Meter: Official laboratory accuracy testing of water meters reporting excessively high readings. Estimated 7–10 working days. Government fee: ₹150 testing fee (Refunded if meter found defective).

procedure_name: Testing and Replacement of Faulty Water Meter
text: Lodge excessive billing complaint. Register dispute citing previous 3 billing cycles on water portal. Required documents: Previous 3 water bills. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Testing and Replacement of Faulty Water Meter
text: Pay lab test deposit. Deposit standard laboratory testing fee at municipal cash counter. Required documents: Fee receipt. Fee: ₹150. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: Testing and Replacement of Faulty Water Meter
text: Meter removal under seal. Municipal plumber visits site, disconnects meter in presence of consumer, and applies tamper seal. Required documents: Removal memo with initial reading. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Testing and Replacement of Faulty Water Meter
text: Laboratory flow calibration test. Meter tested at test bench across slow, medium, and high flow rates. Required documents: Calibration test report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

procedure_name: Testing and Replacement of Faulty Water Meter
text: Replacement and bill adjustment. If error > 5%, meter replaced with calibrated unit and excess billing adjusted in next bill cycle. Required documents: Revised billing advice. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Tree Pruning and Dangerous Branch Removal Permission
text: Tree Pruning and Dangerous Branch Removal Permission: Permit required before pruning or cutting overgrown trees touching power lines or endangering private structures. Estimated 7–12 working days. Government fee: ₹0 for municipal trees; ₹200 fee for private premises.

procedure_name: Tree Pruning and Dangerous Branch Removal Permission
text: Take location photographs. Photograph tree showing dangerous proximity to building wall, roof, or electrical conductors. Required documents: Clear photographs from 2 angles. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

procedure_name: Tree Pruning and Dangerous Branch Removal Permission
text: Submit online request. Submit request on municipal citizen portal specifying species (if known) and reason for cutting/pruning. Required documents: Property ownership proof. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Tree Pruning and Dangerous Branch Removal Permission
text: Horticulture inspector site appraisal. Horticulture officer visits premises to confirm hazard and issue pruning guidance. Required documents: Site appraisal report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 working days.

procedure_name: Tree Pruning and Dangerous Branch Removal Permission
text: Issuance of work permit. Municipal department dispatches bucket crane for street trees, or issues written clearance for private courtyard trees. Required documents: Pruning sanction letter. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Rainwater Harvesting System Certification & Property Tax Rebate
text: Rainwater Harvesting System Certification & Property Tax Rebate: Certification of functional rainwater harvesting pits to claim up to 10% annual rebate on property tax. Estimated 14–20 working days. Government fee: ₹0 application fee.

procedure_name: Rainwater Harvesting System Certification & Property Tax Rebate
text: Construct RWH pit per bylaws. Ensure recharge pit, filtration bed, and desilting chamber conform to municipal engineering specifications. Required documents: Construction bills, Photographs of pit. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 5–7 days.

procedure_name: Rainwater Harvesting System Certification & Property Tax Rebate
text: Apply for RWH certificate. Submit online application with property tax assessment number and plumber completion certificate. Required documents: Property tax bill, Plumbing certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Rainwater Harvesting System Certification & Property Tax Rebate
text: Site inspection by junior engineer. JE inspects catchment slope, filter media, and injection well to confirm operational status. Required documents: JE inspection sheet. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7 days.

procedure_name: Rainwater Harvesting System Certification & Property Tax Rebate
text: Issuance of RWH Compliance Certificate. Executive Engineer approves certificate valid for 3 financial years. Required documents: RWH Certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

procedure_name: Rainwater Harvesting System Certification & Property Tax Rebate
text: Automatic tax rebate linkage. Rebate automatically applied as deduction in annual property tax bill. Required documents: Updated tax demand notice. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: Street Light Repair & New Pole Installation
text: Street Light Repair & New Pole Installation: Mechanism to report non-functional public LED streetlights or request dark-spot illumination poles. Estimated 24–48 hours for repair; 15 days for new pole. Government fee: ₹0 (Completely Free Municipal Service).

procedure_name: Street Light Repair & New Pole Installation
text: Note pole number and landmark. Find the yellow-stenciled pole code or locate exact spot on municipal GIS mobile map. Required documents: Pole serial number, GPS location pin. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 minutes.

procedure_name: Street Light Repair & New Pole Installation
section_title: Log ticket on municipal mobile app
text: Log ticket on municipal mobile app. Submit complaint under 'Street Lighting' category with photo of dark street. Required documents: Complaint ticket number. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 minutes.

procedure_name: Street Light Repair & New Pole Installation
text: Automated dispatch to maintenance van. System dispatches ticket to designated ward electrician with SMS alert. Required documents: Dispatch notification. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 4 hours.

procedure_name: Street Light Repair & New Pole Installation
text: Replacement of LED luminaire / cable. Electrician repairs damaged underground cable or replaces driver/LED luminaire. Required documents: Work closure photo. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 24 hours.

procedure_name: Street Light Repair & New Pole Installation
text: Citizen closure feedback. Citizen receives resolution SMS and rates service quality. Required documents: Feedback confirmation. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: Carcass and Dead Animal Removal Service
text: Carcass and Dead Animal Removal Service: Emergency hygienic lifting and scientific disposal of dead cattle, dogs, and domestic animals. Estimated 2–6 hours emergency response. Government fee: ₹0 for public roads; nominal fee for large farm animals.

procedure_name: Carcass and Dead Animal Removal Service
text: Call municipal toll-free control room. Dial municipal 24x7 control room or submit emergency ticket on municipal portal. Required documents: Exact landmark and animal description. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: Carcass and Dead Animal Removal Service
text: Ticket generation & GPS tagging. Control room operator logs emergency request with geo-tagging for the sanitation fleet. Required documents: Emergency ticket SMS. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 minutes.

procedure_name: Carcass and Dead Animal Removal Service
text: Dedicated carcass recovery van arrival. Sanitation crew equipped with protective gear and disinfectants loads animal carcass. Required documents: Disinfectant spray log. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2–4 hours.

procedure_name: Carcass and Dead Animal Removal Service
text: Bleaching powder sanitization. Crew sprays sodium hypochlorite / bleaching powder on the area to prevent infection spread. Required documents: Site sanitization. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 minutes.

Emergency Potable Water Tanker Booking: Booking of municipal water tankers for private weddings, religious congregations, or pipeline burst emergencies. Estimated 4–12 hours. Government fee: ₹400 – ₹800 per 5,000-litre tanker.
Select delivery slot. Choose date, delivery window (morning/evening), and required water quantity on booking portal. Required documents: Delivery address. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 minutes.

Provide water connection details. Enter existing water account number (if resident) or event sanction letter. Required documents: Water account ID / Event permission. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 minutes.
Pay tanker charges online. Pay fee via UPI/card to receive tanker booking confirmation with driver contact. Required documents: Online booking receipt. Fee: ₹400 – ₹800. Processing time: Immediate.

GPS tracking & delivery. Track tanker in real-time on municipal map and verify water discharge into storage underground sump. Required documents: Delivery acknowledgement. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: At slot.

Municipal Community Centre & Park Booking: Reservation of air-conditioned community centres, banquet halls, and public parks for family functions and weddings. Estimated Immediate online confirmation. Government fee: ₹5,000 – ₹30,000 + refundable security deposit.

Search venue availability. Select ward, community centre, event date, and shift (morning/evening/full day) on calendar view. Required documents: Date and shift selection. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 minutes.
Fill applicant credentials. Submit Aadhaar of event organizer, residential address, and nature of gathering. Required documents: Aadhaar card, PAN card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 minutes.

Pay rental and security deposit. Make online payment for booking charges, sanitation fee, and refundable security deposit. Required documents: Payment gateway receipt. Fee: ₹5,000 – ₹30,000. Processing time: Immediate.
Obtain booking permit. Download official allotment letter and gate entry pass to present to security warden. Required documents: Allotment letter with QR code. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

Security deposit refund. Deposit refunded directly to source bank account within 7 days after function if no property damage occurs. Required documents: Bank account IFSC. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7 days post-event.

department: Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA) & Water Resources Dept
text: Borewell Drilling & Groundwater Extraction NOC: Mandatory prior permission to drill deep borewells or tubewells to extract groundwater. Estimated 30–45 working days. Government fee: ₹1,000 application fee + abstraction charges.

department: Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA) & Water Resources Dept
text: Verify groundwater notification zone. Check whether property falls in 'Safe', 'Semi-Critical', or 'Over-Exploited/Notified' zone. Required documents: Zone advisory status. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

department: Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA) & Water Resources Dept
text: Submit hydrogeological report. Upload hydrogeological feasibility report prepared by accredited groundwater consultant. Required documents: Consultant report, Proposed depth and diameter. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 5 days.

department: Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA) & Water Resources Dept
section_title: Submit online application on CGWA portal
text: Submit online application on CGWA portal. Attach property land ownership documents, water requirement calculation, and flow meter proposal. Required documents: Khasra/Khatauni or Registry, Digital flow meter invoice. Fee: ₹1,000. Processing time: 2 days.

department: Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA) & Water Resources Dept
text: District advisory committee scrutiny. District Ground Water Cell scrutinizes non-availability of piped water supply before granting permit. Required documents: Committee evaluation report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 20 days.

department: Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA) & Water Resources Dept
text: Drilling permission with telemetry condition. Obtain formal drilling permit with mandatory condition of installing tamper-proof digital flow meter. Required documents: NOC Certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

Public Water Hydrant / Standpost Sanction: Community application to install public drinking water coolers or standposts in public squares and markets. Estimated 15–20 working days. Government fee: ₹0 (Funded by Municipal / Ward Councillor funds).

Resident welfare association resolution. Adopt resolution by market association or RWA highlighting public footfall and drinking water need. Required documents: Signed resolution, Signatures of 20+ residents. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

section_title: Submit proposal to Ward Councillor / Superintending Engineer
text: Submit proposal to Ward Councillor / Superintending Engineer. Submit request specifying exact footpath or park corner location. Required documents: Site layout photograph. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.
Feasibility check by water division. Engineers inspect pipeline water pressure and drainage outlet availability. Required documents: Technical feasibility report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7 days.
Work order execution. Municipal contractors lay pipe connection and construct tiled platform with automatic taps. Required documents: Work order copy. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 days.

Mechanical Septic Tank Emptying (FSSM): Safe, mechanized desludging of residential septic tanks by authorized vacuum suction tankers. Estimated 24–48 hours. Government fee: ₹1,000 – ₹2,500 per tanker trip.
Online slot booking. Select residential location and estimate tank volume on municipal septage portal. Required documents: Address proof, Contact number. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 minutes.
Pay government approved tariff. Avoid illegal private dumpers by paying fixed municipal desludging fee. Required documents: Payment receipt. Fee: ₹1,000 – ₹2,500. Processing time: Immediate.
Vacuum tanker dispatch. GPS-tracked vacuum truck arrives with safety equipment and flexible suction hoses. Required documents: Tanker dispatch notice. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 24 hours.

section_title: Safe disposal at Sewage Treatment Plant (STP)
text: Safe disposal at Sewage Treatment Plant (STP). Waste transported to certified treatment facility; citizen receives scientific disposal receipt. Required documents: Disposal acknowledgement. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: Stray Cattle & Dog Animal Birth Control (ABC) Request
text: Stray Cattle & Dog Animal Birth Control (ABC) Request: Request for relocation of aggressive stray cattle to gaushalas, or vaccination/sterilization of community dogs under ABC rules. Estimated 24 hours for cattle; 3–5 days for ABC dog sterilization. Government fee: ₹0 (Municipal Public Service).

procedure_name: Stray Cattle & Dog Animal Birth Control (ABC) Request
text: Register complaint on citizen app. Select 'Stray Animal Issue', upload photograph of animal group, and provide exact street landmark. Required documents: Location photograph, Colony address. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 minutes.

procedure_name: Stray Cattle & Dog Animal Birth Control (ABC) Request
text: Cattle catching squad dispatch. Specialized vehicle equipped with hydraulic ramp impounds stray cattle and transports them to municipal gaushala. Required documents: Impounding log. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 24 hours.

procedure_name: Stray Cattle & Dog Animal Birth Control (ABC) Request
section_title: Animal Birth Control (ABC) process for dogs
text: Animal Birth Control (ABC) process for dogs. Registered animal welfare NGO captures dogs humanely, performs spaying/neutering, rabies vaccination, ear notching, and releases them back into original territory. Required documents: ABC surgical log. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3–5 days.

procedure_name: Stray Cattle & Dog Animal Birth Control (ABC) Request
text: Confirmation SMS. Complainant receives resolution alert with photograph of cleared area. Required documents: Closure confirmation. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: Property Mutation (Transfer of Title in Revenue Records)
text: Property Mutation (Transfer of Title in Revenue Records): Official update of municipal and revenue land ownership records following property purchase, gift, inheritance, or partition. Estimated 15–30 working days. Government fee: ₹500 – ₹2,000 mutation fee.

procedure_name: Property Mutation (Transfer of Title in Revenue Records)
text: Gather registered transfer deed. Obtain certified copy of Registered Sale Deed, Gift Deed, Relinquishment Deed, or Probate of Will. Required documents: Registered Deed, Previous owner title deed. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Property Mutation (Transfer of Title in Revenue Records)
text: Apply online on Revenue Portal. Submit mutation application providing property unique identification number (UPRN), seller and buyer particulars. Required documents: Aadhaar, PAN, Registered Deed copy. Fee: ₹500. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Property Mutation (Transfer of Title in Revenue Records)
text: Issuance of 15-day public notice. Patwari/Tehsildar issues a 15-day public notice to invite objections from legal heirs or co-sharers. Required documents: Public proclamation notice. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 days.

procedure_name: Property Mutation (Transfer of Title in Revenue Records)
text: Verification of possession. Field revenue inspector inspects property to verify actual physical possession. Required documents: Inspector field verification report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

procedure_name: Property Mutation (Transfer of Title in Revenue Records)
text: Tehsildar sanction and Jamabandi update. Tehsildar sanctions mutation order; property record is updated in the computerized Jamabandi / RoR. Required documents: Sanctioned Mutation Order, Updated Jamabandi / Fard. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

Residential Building Plan Approval (Naksha Sanction): Mandatory architectural drawing sanction before commencing construction or structural alteration of residential houses. Estimated 15–21 working days. Government fee: ₹15 – ₹30 per square yard scrutiny fee + labor cess.

Engage registered architect. Architect prepares computer-aided CAD drawings conforming to FAR, setbacks, height, and parking bylaws. Required documents: Architectural CAD drawings, Structural stability certificate. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 5–7 days.

section_title: Submit via Online Building Plan Approval System (OBPAS)
text: Submit via Online Building Plan Approval System (OBPAS). Upload CAD drawings; automated system runs algorithmic rule-checking against city master plan bylaws. Required documents: Title deed, Possession certificate, Demarcation plan. Fee: ₹1,500 – ₹5,000. Processing time: 1 day.

Multi-department scrutiny. Fire department, public health engineering, and structural division review clearances simultaneously. Required documents: Online scrutiny report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7–10 days.

section_title: Pay building permit fee & labor cess
text: Pay building permit fee & labor cess. Remit approved sanction fees, external development charges, and 1% building workers welfare cess. Required documents: Challan receipt. Fee: Calculated online. Processing time: Immediate.

Download sanctioned building permit. Download digitally stamped Naksha blueprint with QR verification code valid for 3 years. Required documents: Sanctioned Plan PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

Building Completion & Occupancy Certificate (OC): Final legal document certifying that building construction strictly matches approved plans and is safe for human habitation. Estimated 15–21 working days. Government fee: ₹500 application fee.

Obtain Architect Completion Certificate. Architect and structural engineer sign Form of Completion stating construction follows sanctioned plans. Required documents: Architect certificate, As-built drawings. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

Obtain utility completion memos. Procure formal connection memos from sewerage, water supply, and electrical safety wings. Required documents: Water connection slip, Sewerage connection certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

Submit OC application online. Submit application on municipal building portal attaching all NOCs and photographs of all elevations. Required documents: All elevation photos, Rainwater harvesting proof. Fee: ₹500. Processing time: 1 day.

Joint engineering inspection. Municipal team measures setbacks, room heights, parking area, and fire exits against approved blueprint. Required documents: Site inspection measurement book. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7 days.

Issuance of Occupancy Certificate. Municipal Corporation issues Occupancy Certificate enabling permanent utility connections and property sale. Required documents: Occupancy Certificate document. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

Encumbrance Certificate (EC) for Property: Legal document proving property is free from registered financial liabilities, bank mortgages, court attachments, or title claims. Estimated 3–5 working days. Government fee: ₹100 – ₹300 search fee based on period.

Identify property survey/khasra number. Locate exact village, sector, survey/plot number, and previous deed registered numbers. Required documents: Previous sale deed copy. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 minutes.

Apply on Sub-Registrar online portal. Enter search period (e.g. 15 or 30 years), applicant details, and property boundary descriptions. Required documents: Aadhaar card. Fee: ₹100 – ₹300. Processing time: 1 day.
Sub-registrar index verification. Department records examiner searches Book 1 registered property deed archives. Required documents: Archive index search. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

Download Nil Encumbrance Certificate (Form 15/16). Receive digitally signed EC certifying clean title or listing registered mortgages/encumbrances. Required documents: Encumbrance Certificate PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

procedure_name: Property Tax Self-Assessment & Annual Return Filing
text: Property Tax Self-Assessment & Annual Return Filing: Annual self-declaration of property unit area, covered area, and usage category to calculate and remit municipal house tax. Estimated Immediate online receipt. Government fee: Varies by covered area & circle rate (Early bird rebate up to 10%).

procedure_name: Property Tax Self-Assessment & Annual Return Filing
section_title: Look up Property ID / Assessment Number
text: Look up Property ID / Assessment Number. Enter 10-digit Property ID or registered mobile number on municipal property tax portal. Required documents: Previous property tax receipt. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: Property Tax Self-Assessment & Annual Return Filing
text: Review property particulars. Verify land plot area, covered carpet area across floors, residential vs commercial occupancy, and tenant details. Required documents: Property measurements. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 minutes.

procedure_name: Property Tax Self-Assessment & Annual Return Filing
text: System tax calculation with rebates. System calculates gross tax, applies early bird 10% discount and senior citizen/female owner concession. Required documents: Computed tax demand breakdown. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: Property Tax Self-Assessment & Annual Return Filing
section_title: Pay online via instant payment gateway
text: Pay online via instant payment gateway. Pay via UPI, credit/debit card, or download bank challan for payment at designated authorized banks. Required documents: Instant tax payment receipt. Fee: Calculated tax amount. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: Property Tax Self-Assessment & Annual Return Filing
text: Download annual property tax clearance. Download property tax clearance certificate for the current financial year. Required documents: Tax Clearance Certificate with QR. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Property Sale / Conveyance
department: Urban Estate / Housing Board / Development Authority
text: No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Property Sale / Conveyance: Mandatory clearance certifying no pending installments, encroachment, or building violations prior to deed registration. Estimated 15–21 working days. Government fee: ₹1,000 – ₹2,500 scrutiny fee.

procedure_name: No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Property Sale / Conveyance
department: Urban Estate / Housing Board / Development Authority
text: Clear all outstanding dues. Pay pending water bills, property tax, and lease rent arrears up to the current quarter. Required documents: No dues receipts from water/tax branches. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Property Sale / Conveyance
department: Urban Estate / Housing Board / Development Authority
text: Submit transfer NOC request. Upload allotment letter, possession slip, proposed buyer identity proofs, and non-encroachment affidavit. Required documents: Allotment letter, Indemnity bond and affidavits. Fee: ₹1,000. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Property Sale / Conveyance
department: Urban Estate / Housing Board / Development Authority
text: Field inspection by enforcement wing. Authority junior engineer visits plot to verify that no illegal construction or boundary encroachment exists. Required documents: Inspection report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7 days.

procedure_name: No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Property Sale / Conveyance
department: Urban Estate / Housing Board / Development Authority
text: Scrutiny of legal title. Estate officer's legal cell verifies original files and legal heir succession records. Required documents: Legal scrutiny memo. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

procedure_name: No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Property Sale / Conveyance
department: Urban Estate / Housing Board / Development Authority
text: Issuance of Transfer NOC. Receive formal Permission to Transfer / No Dues NOC authorizing sub-registrar registration. Required documents: Transfer NOC letter. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Refund of Unused / Spoiled E-Stamp Paper Duty
text: Refund of Unused / Spoiled E-Stamp Paper Duty: Procedure to recover up to 90% of stamp duty paid on cancelled property purchase transactions or spoiled stamp papers. Estimated 30–45 working days. Government fee: 10% statutory deduction from total stamp value.

procedure_name: Refund of Unused / Spoiled E-Stamp Paper Duty
text: Preserve original e-stamp certificate. Ensure application is submitted within statutory 6 months from e-stamp certificate purchase date. Required documents: Original e-stamp certificate, Purchase receipt. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Refund of Unused / Spoiled E-Stamp Paper Duty
text: Affidavit of cancellation. Execute sworn affidavit before notary stating reasons for cancellation and that deed was never executed/registered. Required documents: Notarized cancellation affidavit. Fee: ₹100. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Refund of Unused / Spoiled E-Stamp Paper Duty
text: Sub-registrar non-registration certificate. Sub-Registrar inspects archives and issues certificate confirming stamp was never used for registration. Required documents: Non-use certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7 days.

procedure_name: Refund of Unused / Spoiled E-Stamp Paper Duty
text: Submit refund claim to Collector. Submit application to District Collector (Stamps) with bank account details for Direct Benefit Transfer. Required documents: Cancelled cheque, PAN card copy. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Refund of Unused / Spoiled E-Stamp Paper Duty
section_title: Order of refund and bank credit
text: Order of refund and bank credit. Collector approves refund deducting 10% statutory fee; amount credited to buyer's bank account. Required documents: Refund sanction order. Fee: 10% deduction. Processing time: 15–20 days.

department: Tehsil Office / Department of Revenue & Land Records
text: Official Land Boundary Demarcation (Nishandehi): Official measurement and boundary pegging by government revenue surveyor (Kanungo/Patwari) to resolve boundary disputes. Estimated 15–25 working days. Government fee: ₹200 – ₹500 government fee.

department: Tehsil Office / Department of Revenue & Land Records
text: Obtain latest Jamabandi and Sajra (Map). Procure certified computerized land records (Fard) and village cadastral map from revenue center. Required documents: Certified Jamabandi copy, Sajra map extract. Fee: ₹50. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Tehsil Office / Department of Revenue & Land Records
text: Apply to Tehsildar for Nishandehi. Submit demarcation application citing Khasra/Killa numbers and adjoining landowner details. Required documents: Application form, Aadhaar card. Fee: ₹200. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Tehsil Office / Department of Revenue & Land Records
text: Notice to adjoining boundary owners. Tehsildar issues written notices summoning owners of all four adjacent plots to be present on site. Required documents: Summon notices. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7 days.

department: Tehsil Office / Department of Revenue & Land Records
text: Field measurement by Kanungo & ETS/DGPS. Revenue team measures from fixed benchmark points using Electronic Total Station / metric chain. Required documents: Measurement field book. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Tehsil Office / Department of Revenue & Land Records
text: Boundary stone fixation & report sign-off. Fix boundary pegs in presence of all parties; prepare Panchnama report signed by panchas. Required documents: Demarcation Panchnama report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

Change of Land Use (CLU) Permission: Sanction to convert agricultural land into commercial, institutional, or industrial operational use. Estimated 45–60 working days. Government fee: Scrutiny fee + Conversion charges based on master plan zone.
Master plan zone verification. Confirm whether land falls inside designated urbanizable boundary in city master plan. Required documents: Master plan zoning map. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Comprehensive project report (CPR). Prepare project report showing proposed land use, access road width, water demand, and effluent treatment. Required documents: CPR document, Architectural layout. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 7 days.

Submit CLU application online. Submit Jamabandi, Aks Shajra, non-encumbrance certificate, and scrutiny fee on state town planning portal. Required documents: Title deeds, Cadastral map, Mutation copies. Fee: Calculated online. Processing time: 2 days.

Inter-departmental clearance (IDC). Public works, forest, irrigation, and pollution boards examine site access and flood plains. Required documents: Departmental NOCs. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 30 days.

section_title: Grant of In-Principle CLU & Letter of Intent
text: Grant of In-Principle CLU & Letter of Intent. Director of Town Planning issues formal CLU sanction order upon payment of conversion charges. Required documents: CLU Sanction Certificate. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 10 days.

procedure_name: Certified Copy of Registered Sale / Title Deed
text: Certified Copy of Registered Sale / Title Deed: Procuring legally admissible certified copies of registered title deeds from government registration records. Estimated 2–4 working days. Government fee: ₹100 – ₹250 search & copying fee.

procedure_name: Certified Copy of Registered Sale / Title Deed
text: Identify registration details. Find registration document number, book number, volume number, and exact registration date. Required documents: Registration details from previous receipt. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 minutes.

procedure_name: Certified Copy of Registered Sale / Title Deed
section_title: Apply online or at Sub-Registrar counter
text: Apply online or at Sub-Registrar counter. Fill certified copy requisition form specifying purpose (court, bank loan, title verification). Required documents: Applicant ID proof. Fee: ₹100 – ₹250. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Certified Copy of Registered Sale / Title Deed
text: Sub-registrar record retrieval. Record keeper retrieves original volume record from record room or digital repository. Required documents: Archival file lookup. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Certified Copy of Registered Sale / Title Deed
text: Affixing official seal and signature. Sub-Registrar stamps 'Certified True Copy' with official holographic seal. Required documents: Certified stamped copy. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Certified Copy of Registered Sale / Title Deed
text: Collection / Digital download. Download digitally signed PDF or collect certified physical copy from delivery counter. Required documents: Certified Title Deed PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

procedure_name: Conversion of Leasehold Property to Freehold
text: Conversion of Leasehold Property to Freehold: Legal transformation of 99-year municipal/housing board leased property into absolute private freehold ownership. Estimated 30–45 working days. Government fee: Prescribed conversion fee based on plot size & circle rate.

procedure_name: Conversion of Leasehold Property to Freehold
text: Clear annual ground rent arrears. Obtain no-dues receipt for ground rent and municipal service maintenance charges. Required documents: No dues receipt. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Conversion of Leasehold Property to Freehold
section_title: Submit application with chain of title
text: Submit application with chain of title. Upload original lease deed, all GPA/agreement chain documents, and architectural compliance affidavit. Required documents: Original lease deed, Chain agreements, Building non-violation affidavit. Fee: ₹1,000. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Conversion of Leasehold Property to Freehold
text: Building violation inspection. Junior engineer inspects site to confirm absence of unapproved additional floors or misuse of residential premises. Required documents: Inspection report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 14 days.

procedure_name: Conversion of Leasehold Property to Freehold
text: Demand note payment. Estate office generates conversion demand notice; pay through RTGS or demand draft. Required documents: Payment confirmation. Fee: Calculated by formula. Processing time: 7 days.

procedure_name: Conversion of Leasehold Property to Freehold
text: Execution of Freehold Conveyance Deed. Sign and register Conveyance Deed before Sub-Registrar, granting permanent absolute ownership. Required documents: Registered Conveyance Deed. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

department: State Police Department / Local Police Station
text: Tenant & Domestic Worker Police Verification: Mandatory tenant background verification under Criminal Procedure Code to ensure neighborhood security. Estimated 3–7 working days. Government fee: ₹0 (Completely Free of Cost).

department: State Police Department / Local Police Station
text: Collect tenant identity documents. Obtain tenant's Aadhaar card, permanent native village address, employer identity card, and 2 passport photos. Required documents: Tenant Aadhaar & PAN, Employer ID card, Passport photos. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

department: State Police Department / Local Police Station
section_title: Submit on Citizen Police Portal / App
text: Submit on Citizen Police Portal / App. Landlord registers property details and submits tenant personal history online. Required documents: Rent agreement copy. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 minutes.

department: State Police Department / Local Police Station
text: Local police station verification. Beat constable conducts background check and verifies record with native district police station. Required documents: Beat officer enquiry log. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3–5 days.

department: State Police Department / Local Police Station
text: Download Police Clearance Slip. Download digitally stamped verification acknowledgement receipt for records. Required documents: Verification Acknowledgement PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: Water & Sewerage Charge Waiver for Vacant Property
text: Water & Sewerage Charge Waiver for Vacant Property: Suspension of monthly minimum consumption and sewerage charges for unoccupied residential properties. Estimated 7–10 working days. Government fee: ₹0 application fee.

procedure_name: Water & Sewerage Charge Waiver for Vacant Property
section_title: Ensure electricity meter disconnection / zero usage
text: Ensure electricity meter disconnection / zero usage. Provide electricity bills showing zero power units consumed during the vacant period. Required documents: Last 2 power bills. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Water & Sewerage Charge Waiver for Vacant Property
text: Apply for vacant status endorsement. Submit sworn affidavit from homeowner affirming that property remains locked and uninhabited. Required documents: Owner affidavit, Water bill copy. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Water & Sewerage Charge Waiver for Vacant Property
text: Inspection by meter reader. Meter reader visits house to confirm locked status and record final dial reading. Required documents: Field inspection note. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

procedure_name: Water & Sewerage Charge Waiver for Vacant Property
text: Approval of billing suspension. Executive Engineer endorses vacant status, pausing recurring fixed sewage and meter charges. Required documents: Billing adjustment order. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

Heritage Building Renovation & Alteration Clearance: Special permission required before undertaking repair, painting, or window replacement on notified heritage facade structures. Estimated 30–60 working days. Government fee: ₹1,000 application fee.

Prepare heritage impact assessment. Architectural conservationist prepares structural report preserving character-defining elements. Required documents: Conservation report, Historical photographs. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 7 days.

Submit proposal to Heritage Committee. Submit proposed materials, paint swatches matching original exposed brick/concrete aesthetic. Required documents: Material specifications, Elevation mockups. Fee: ₹1,000. Processing time: 2 days.

Heritage Conservation Committee review. Panel of architects and historians assesses whether facade integrity is preserved. Required documents: Committee meeting minutes. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 20 days.
Issuance of Facade Clearance NOC. Obtain conditional approval letter with strict preservation directives. Required documents: Heritage NOC. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

Sub-Division and Amalgamation of Plots: Formal approval to split a large land parcel into sub-plots or merge adjacent plots into a single unified title. Estimated 25–35 working days. Government fee: ₹10,000 – ₹50,000 based on area.
Check minimum plot size bylaws. Verify that resulting sub-plots satisfy minimum frontage and area requirements. Required documents: Title deeds of both plots. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Submit amalgamation/subdivision layout. Registered town planner drafts revised layout showing utility easements and setbacks. Required documents: Draft layout plan, Structural engineer certificate. Fee: ₹2,500. Processing time: 5 days.
Joint engineering scrutiny. Municipal planning cell examines access road width and water/sewer network capacity. Required documents: Scrutiny report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 14 days.
Pay amalgamation fee. Pay development and regularization charges at municipal treasury. Required documents: Treasury challan. Fee: ₹10,000 – ₹50,000. Processing time: Immediate.

Issuance of unified property ID. Receive revised allotment letter and single consolidated property tax assessment ID. Required documents: Unified Property Allotment Letter. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

Property Misuse Regularization & Penalty Clearance: Removal of misuse violation notices or regularization of permitted non-conforming activities in designated sectors. Estimated 15–20 working days. Government fee: Penalty calculated per sq. ft. per month of violation.

Rectify violation on site. Restore premises to sanctioned use (e.g. remove commercial storage from residential basement). Required documents: Photographs of cleared area. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 3 days.

Submit compliance affidavit. Submit notarized undertaking on stamp paper stating non-recurrence of violation. Required documents: Notarized undertaking, Violation notice copy. Fee: ₹100. Processing time: 1 day.
Enforcement inspector re-inspection. Building inspector re-inspects premises, measures area, and takes geo-tagged photos. Required documents: Re-inspection report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7 days.
Pay assessed compounding penalty. Pay compounding penalty determined by the Assistant Estate Officer. Required documents: Payment receipt. Fee: Varies. Processing time: Immediate.

Discharge of misuse show-cause notice. Estate Office issues formal closure letter revoking resumption/misuse proceedings. Required documents: Revocation / Clean Chit Letter. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

Property Valuation Certificate (Circle Rate Assessment): Official certificate determining minimum government circle rate valuation of real estate for visa, probate, or bank mortgage. Estimated 3–5 working days. Government fee: ₹200 application fee.

section_title: Identify sector, floor, and road width
text: Identify sector, floor, and road width. Circle rate valuations vary based on whether property abuts main sector avenue or internal road. Required documents: Registry copy / Allotment letter. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 minutes.
Apply online on Revenue Portal. Input plot size, constructed area by floor, and year of construction. Required documents: Aadhaar, Property photos. Fee: ₹200. Processing time: 1 day.

Algorithmic circle rate assessment. System multiplies carpet area by notification circle rates and applies age depreciation. Required documents: Valuation computation sheet. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

Issuance of certified valuation. Sub-Registrar issues digitally signed Valuation Certificate with QR code verification. Required documents: Valuation Certificate PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

department: Office of the Registrar of Births & Deaths
text: Birth Certificate Registration & Download: Official registration and certificate issuance for newborn children within 21 days of birth. Estimated 3–7 working days. Government fee: ₹0 within 21 days; ₹10–₹50 late fee up to 1 year.

department: Office of the Registrar of Births & Deaths
text: Hospital discharge institutional report. Collect Form 1 institutional report generated by hospital/maternity nursing home. Required documents: Hospital Form 1 report, Discharge card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: At discharge.

department: Office of the Registrar of Births & Deaths
text: Submit child's name online. Log in to Civil Registration System (CRS) portal and register baby's official name. Required documents: Mother and Father Aadhaar cards, Marriage certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Office of the Registrar of Births & Deaths
text: Verification by Registrar. Municipal birth registrar verifies institutional logs against hospital registers. Required documents: Registrar verification memo. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

department: Office of the Registrar of Births & Deaths
text: Download digital birth certificate. Download digitally signed Birth Certificate with national QR code; download unlimited copies free. Required documents: Birth Certificate PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

Death Certificate Issuance & Cremation Record: Statutory registration of demise required for succession, life insurance claims, and bank account settlements. Estimated 3–5 working days. Government fee: ₹0 within 21 days.

Cremation/burial slip. Collect cremation ground receipt or burial ground entry counterfoil signed by ground caretaker. Required documents: Crematorium receipt, Hospital medical cause of death Form 4. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

Apply online on CRS portal. Submit deceased identity details, date, exact place of death, and applicant relation proof. Required documents: Deceased Aadhaar, Applicant Aadhaar. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.
Registrar scrutiny. Health department officer crosses-references cremation logbook records. Required documents: Verification check. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.
Download official death certificate. Obtain official digitally signed Death Certificate with unique registration number. Required documents: Death Certificate PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

procedure_name: Marriage Registration & Certificate (Special / Hindu Marriage Act)
text: Marriage Registration & Certificate (Special / Hindu Marriage Act): Legal registration of marriage under Hindu Marriage Act 1955 or Special Marriage Act 1954. Estimated 7–15 working days (Hindu) / 30 days notice (Special). Government fee: ₹100 – ₹500 government fee.

procedure_name: Marriage Registration & Certificate (Special / Hindu Marriage Act)
text: Compile couple's documents. Age proof (matriculation certificate/passport), address proofs, joint wedding photographs, and wedding card. Required documents: Age & Address proofs of bride and groom, Wedding invitation card, Joint photo. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Marriage Registration & Certificate (Special / Hindu Marriage Act)
text: Submit application on e-District portal. Fill online marriage form, enter particulars of 3 witnesses, and book appointment slot. Required documents: Witness Aadhaar cards. Fee: ₹100 – ₹500. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Marriage Registration & Certificate (Special / Hindu Marriage Act)
text: Physical appearance before Marriage Officer. Couple and 3 witnesses appear before SDM/Registrar to sign official marriage register. Required documents: Original documents for physical verification. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: On appointment date.
