procedure_name: Marriage Registration & Certificate (Special / Hindu Marriage Act)
text: Issuance of Marriage Certificate. Download government Marriage Certificate bearing official seal and registration number. Required documents: Marriage Certificate PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day / next day.

department: Revenue Department / Office of the Tehsildar
text: Caste Certificate (SC / ST / OBC / EWS): Government certificate authenticating reservation category status for education admissions and public recruitment. Estimated 10–15 working days. Government fee: ₹30 – ₹60 service fee.

department: Revenue Department / Office of the Tehsildar
text: Paternal lineage proof. Father's caste certificate or revenue land records before 1966 proving state ancestral residency. Required documents: Father's caste certificate, Old lineage records. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Revenue Department / Office of the Tehsildar
text: Apply online on e-District. Upload applicant Aadhaar, school leaving certificate, and non-creamy layer income certificate (for OBC/EWS). Required documents: Applicant Aadhaar, Income certificate, Family ration card. Fee: ₹30. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Revenue Department / Office of the Tehsildar
text: Field inquiry by Patwari. Halqa Patwari and Kanungo verify applicant's family history in ancestral village. Required documents: Patwari verification report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5–7 days.

department: Revenue Department / Office of the Tehsildar
text: Tehsildar approval and certificate generation. Tehsildar sanctions certificate with unique central/state serial number. Required documents: Caste Certificate PDF with QR. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

department: Office of the Tehsildar / Sub-Divisional Magistrate
text: Income Certificate for Scholarships & Welfare: Certified proof of total annual household income required for fee concessions, scholarships, and subsidized housing. Estimated 7–10 working days. Government fee: ₹30 – ₹50 government fee.

department: Office of the Tehsildar / Sub-Divisional Magistrate
text: Income declaration & employer slip. Salary slips / Form 16 for salaried individuals; ITR or self-declaration affidavit for unorganized workers. Required documents: Salary slip / Form 16 / ITR, Notarized income affidavit. Fee: ₹100. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Office of the Tehsildar / Sub-Divisional Magistrate
text: Submit application on e-District portal. Fill household members details, agricultural land income, and rental income. Required documents: Aadhaar card, Electricity bill, Ration card. Fee: ₹30. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Office of the Tehsildar / Sub-Divisional Magistrate
text: Patwari verification of assets. Patwari visits local neighborhood to verify standard of living and reported income. Required documents: Patwari report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3–5 days.

department: Office of the Tehsildar / Sub-Divisional Magistrate
text: Digital certificate download. Download valid 1-year Income Certificate with official digital signature. Required documents: Income Certificate PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

Domicile / Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC): Legal verification of minimum 5 to 15 years continuous residence within the state or union territory. Estimated 7–12 working days. Government fee: ₹30 – ₹50 fee.

Continuous residence documentation. Provide 10-year education certificates, property ownership registry, or consecutive voter identity card records. Required documents: 10 years school/college certificates, Voter list extracts. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

Submit online e-District request. Upload self-attested copies of birth certificate, parent residence proofs, and passport photograph. Required documents: Aadhaar, Birth certificate, Parent domicile copy. Fee: ₹30. Processing time: 1 day.
Police/Revenue background inquiry. Police or revenue inspector verifies permanent residency claims. Required documents: Verification verification log. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

Issuance of Domicile Certificate. Receive lifetime valid Domicile Certificate essential for state quota college admissions. Required documents: Domicile Certificate PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

Senior Citizen Identity Card: Special ID card for citizens aged 60 and above conferring bus travel concessions, healthcare queue priority, and legal aid. Estimated 5–7 working days. Government fee: ₹0 (Free of Cost).

Age verification. Provide passport, voter ID, matriculation certificate, or Aadhaar proving completion of 60 years. Required documents: Age proof document, Address proof. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

Medical blood group card. Attach blood group report and emergency family doctor/next-of-kin contact details. Required documents: Blood group report, 2 passport photos. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

section_title: Submit online or at Senior Citizen Home
text: Submit online or at Senior Citizen Home. Register on state senior citizen portal or submit at municipal social welfare counter. Required documents: Application form. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.
Collect Senior Citizen Smart Card. Download digital card or collect PVC laminated card with photo and blood group. Required documents: Senior Citizen Card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
text: Unique Disability ID (UDID) & Disability Certificate: Universal digital card and medical board certificate recognizing 21 specified disabilities under RPwD Act 2016. Estimated 15–30 working days. Government fee: ₹0 (Free Government Service).

department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
text: Register on Swavlamban portal. Submit personal details, disability type (locomotor, visual, hearing, intellectual, etc.), and address. Required documents: Aadhaar card, Passport size photograph. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
text: Book medical assessment appointment. System assigns date for evaluation at District Civil Hospital Medical Board. Required documents: Appointment slip. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
text: Medical board physical evaluation. Panel of specialist doctors conducts tests and determines disability percentage (e.g. 40%+ benchmark disability). Required documents: Doctor clinical assessment notes. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: On appointment date.

department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
text: Download Disability Certificate. Chief Medical Officer (CMO) signs digital certificate stating permanent/temporary disability percentage. Required documents: Disability Certificate PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
text: Receive National UDID Smart Card. Plastic UDID card with smart chip dispatched by speed post to home address. Required documents: UDID Card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 14 days post-approval.

procedure_name: New Ration Card (APL / BPL / NFSA / Antyodaya)
text: New Ration Card (APL / BPL / NFSA / Antyodaya): Issuance of digital household ration card for subsidized food grains and official proof of family tree. Estimated 15–25 working days. Government fee: ₹50 service fee.

procedure_name: New Ration Card (APL / BPL / NFSA / Antyodaya)
text: Deletion certificate from previous place. If moving from another state/town, obtain surrender/deletion certificate from previous food supply office. Required documents: Surrender certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

procedure_name: New Ration Card (APL / BPL / NFSA / Antyodaya)
text: Gather family member Aadhaar cards. Collect Aadhaar numbers and bank account of the eldest female member as Head of the Family (HOD). Required documents: All members' Aadhaar, LPG gas connection booklet. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: New Ration Card (APL / BPL / NFSA / Antyodaya)
text: Submit online NFSA application. Fill monthly income, house type (pucca/kutcha), and upload family group photo. Required documents: Family photo, Electricity bill. Fee: ₹50. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: New Ration Card (APL / BPL / NFSA / Antyodaya)
text: Food Inspector field scrutiny. Inspector checks economic criteria and verifies family living conditions. Required documents: Inspector verification log. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 days.

procedure_name: New Ration Card (APL / BPL / NFSA / Antyodaya)
text: Download e-Ration Card. Download dynamic QR-code e-Ration Card valid at all Fair Price Shops under One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC). Required documents: e-Ration Card PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

department: Revenue Department / Office of the SDM
text: Legal Heir / Surviving Member Certificate: Certificate identifying all surviving legal heirs of a deceased person for bank account closure and PF settlements. Estimated 15–21 working days. Government fee: ₹50 application fee.

department: Revenue Department / Office of the SDM
text: Death certificate of deceased. Obtain official death certificate and family pedigree genealogical tree. Required documents: Death certificate, Family tree diagram. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Revenue Department / Office of the SDM
text: Affidavit of all legal heirs. All surviving heirs (spouse, sons, daughters, mother) execute joint affidavit declaring no other heirs exist. Required documents: Notarized joint legal heir affidavit. Fee: ₹100. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Revenue Department / Office of the SDM
text: Submit online SDM application. Upload death certificate, survivor Aadhaar cards, and NOC from married daughters (if applicable). Required documents: Surviving members' Aadhaar. Fee: ₹50. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Revenue Department / Office of the SDM
text: Local Patwari/Tehsildar verification. Revenue officer verifies surviving heirs through statements of village Sarpanch or municipal councillor. Required documents: Field enquiry report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 days.

department: Revenue Department / Office of the SDM
text: Issuance of Surviving Member Certificate. SDM issues formal Surviving Member Certificate with names and relationship of all legal heirs. Required documents: Legal Heir Certificate PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

department: Department of Publication, Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
text: Name Change Official Gazette Notification: Legally binding change of personal name published in the Official Government Gazette for passport and educational records. Estimated 20–30 working days. Government fee: ₹1,100 – ₹1,500 government gazette printing fee.

department: Department of Publication, Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
text: Sworn name change affidavit. Execute affidavit before Judicial Magistrate or Notary stating old name, new name, and father's name. Required documents: Notarized name change affidavit. Fee: ₹100. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Department of Publication, Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
text: Publish newspaper advertisements. Publish short name change notice in two prominent local daily newspapers (one English, one Hindi/regional). Required documents: Original newspaper cuttings. Fee: ₹500 – ₹1,000. Processing time: 2 days.

department: Department of Publication, Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
text: Prepare Gazette Proforma & CD. Draft official proforma and burn MS Word soft copy onto a compact disc (CD). Required documents: Hardcopy proforma, Softcopy CD with certificate. Fee: ₹100. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Department of Publication, Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
section_title: Submit dossier to Controller of Publications
text: Submit dossier to Controller of Publications. Submit complete file with fee receipt via registered post or at Civil Lines Delhi counter. Required documents: Application packet, Fee challan via Bharatkosh. Fee: ₹1,100 – ₹1,500. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Department of Publication, Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
text: Download e-Gazette notification. Download published Gazette notification from egazette.gov.in to update Passport, Aadhaar, and Bank. Required documents: e-Gazette extract PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15–20 days.

Aadhaar Card Demographic & Biometric Update: Update of residential address, mobile phone number, name, or mandatory 10-year biometric refresh. Estimated 3–7 working days. Government fee: ₹50 for address/demographic; ₹100 for biometrics.

Address update online (Self-Service). Upload valid address proof (electricity bill, passport, rent agreement) on myAadhaar portal. Required documents: Valid address proof document. Fee: ₹50. Processing time: 15 minutes.
Biometric/Mobile update appointment. Book time slot at nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra (ASK) or post office branch. Required documents: Appointment slip. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 minutes.

Iris, fingerprint & facial photo scan. Visit center for live ten-fingerprint, iris scan, and photograph update. Required documents: Original Aadhaar number. Fee: ₹100. Processing time: 15 minutes at center.
Track with URN. Track 14-digit Update Request Number (URN) on UIDAI tracking page. Required documents: URN acknowledgement slip. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.
Download updated e-Aadhaar. Download password-protected e-Aadhaar PDF using registered mobile OTP. Required documents: e-Aadhaar PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3–5 days.

department: State Police Department / Criminal Investigation Branch
text: Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) for Employment: Verification certifying individual has no active criminal convictions, arrest warrants, or pending FIRs. Estimated 7–10 working days. Government fee: ₹200 – ₹500 fee.

department: State Police Department / Criminal Investigation Branch
text: Submit online verification request. Enter personal biographical history, previous 5 years addresses, and employer requisition letter. Required documents: Aadhaar, Passport, Employer letter. Fee: ₹200. Processing time: 1 day.

department: State Police Department / Criminal Investigation Branch
text: Crime database cross-checking. Police records branch verifies applicant against CCTNS (Crime and Criminal Tracking Network). Required documents: CCTNS query check. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

department: State Police Department / Criminal Investigation Branch
text: Local police station enquiry. Local beat constable verifies applicant character from two reputable neighborhood references. Required documents: Two neighbor reference statements. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

department: State Police Department / Criminal Investigation Branch
text: Download Police Clearance Certificate. Download digitally stamped Character Verification Certificate with validity QR code. Required documents: PCC document PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

Religious / Linguistic Minority Community Certificate: Official certification of notified minority community status (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) for scholarships. Estimated 7–12 working days. Government fee: ₹30 – ₹50 fee.

Religious institution certificate. Letter from registered Gurudwara/Church/Mosque/Jain trust or school leaving certificate stating religion. Required documents: Institutional letter, School leaving certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.
Self-declaration affidavit. Submit sworn affidavit declaring adherence to notified minority community. Required documents: Notarized affidavit. Fee: ₹100. Processing time: 1 day.
Apply online on e-District portal. Attach parent minority proof and family income statement for fee waivers. Required documents: Aadhaar card, Income certificate. Fee: ₹30. Processing time: 1 day.

text: Employment Exchange Registration for Jobseekers: Official registration card establishing educational seniority for state government employment drives. Estimated Immediate online certificate. Government fee: ₹0 (Completely Free).

text: Register on National Career Service (NCS). Create jobseeker profile with Aadhaar, education qualification certificates, and technical skills. Required documents: Degree marksheets, Aadhaar card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 minutes.

department: Department of Employment & National Career Service
text: Upload experience and category certificates. Add vocational certifications (ITI, Polytechnic) and caste/disability certificates for reservation. Required documents: Certificates scan. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 minutes.

department: Department of Employment & National Career Service
text: Download Employment Exchange Card. Receive NCS Jobseeker Registration Number and digital employment card. Required documents: NCS Jobseeker Card PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

department: Department of Employment & National Career Service
text: Participate in government job fairs. Receive automated SMS invitations to Rozgar Melas and state vacancy notifications. Required documents: Job fair alert notifications. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Ongoing.

Freedom Fighter Dependent / Ward Certificate: Certificate recognizing sons, daughters, and grandchildren of freedom fighters for horizontal reservation quotas. Estimated 20–30 working days. Government fee: ₹0 (Free Government Service).

Tamra Patra / Sanman Pension proofs. Produce official Tamra Patra award or central Samman Pension sanction order of ancestor. Required documents: Tamra Patra copy, Pension sanction order. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Establish genealogical linkage. Birth certificates and revenue genealogical tree establishing direct bloodline to freedom fighter. Required documents: Certified family pedigree, Birth certificates. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

Submit application to Deputy Commissioner. Submit application to DC Office with affidavits from all intermediate relatives. Required documents: Affidavits, Aadhaar cards. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.
Scrutiny by Freedom Fighter Cell. District advisory committee examines original central ministry records. Required documents: Scrutiny findings. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 days.

Issuance of Ward Certificate. Deputy Commissioner issues formal Ward of Freedom Fighter Certificate for reservation benefits. Required documents: Certificate with DC seal. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
text: Learner's Driving License (LL) Online Test: Application, fee payment, and contactless online road safety test for 6-month Learner's Driving License. Estimated Same day online. Government fee: ₹150 application fee + ₹50 test fee.

department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
text: Apply on Parivahan Sarathi. Select State, authenticate via Aadhaar OTP, and select license classes (e.g. Motorcycle with Gear MCWG, LMV). Required documents: Aadhaar number, Active linked mobile. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 minutes.

department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
text: Watch mandatory road safety tutorial. Watch 10-minute animated road safety video on safe driving practices and traffic signs. Required documents: Completed tutorial confirmation. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 minutes.

department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
text: Pay government LL fee. Pay application and online test fee via integrated payment portal. Required documents: Payment receipt. Fee: ₹200. Processing time: Immediate.

department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
section_title: Appear in online proctored STALL test
text: Appear in online proctored STALL test. Take 15-question multiple choice test on traffic signs from home device using webcam facial recognition. Required documents: Laptop/Phone with camera. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 minutes.

department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
text: Instant Learner License download. Upon scoring 60%+ correct answers, download Form 3 Learner License valid for 6 months across India. Required documents: Form 3 Learner License PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: Permanent Driving License & Automated Track Test
text: Permanent Driving License & Automated Track Test: Booking driving skill track test and obtaining chip-embedded PVC Smart Card Driving License. Estimated 7–10 working days. Government fee: ₹200 driving test fee + ₹200 smart card fee.

procedure_name: Permanent Driving License & Automated Track Test
text: Wait minimum 30 days after LL. Candidate must have held valid Learner's License for at least 30 days before booking DL test slot. Required documents: Valid Learner's License number. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: After 30 days.

procedure_name: Permanent Driving License & Automated Track Test
text: Book automated driving test slot. Select date and preferred RTO automated test track on Sarathi portal. Required documents: Learner license, Form 5 driving school certificate. Fee: ₹400. Processing time: 5 minutes.

procedure_name: Permanent Driving License & Automated Track Test
section_title: Appear at automated driving test track
text: Appear at automated driving test track. Drive on sensor-equipped track executing reverse-S, parallel parking, eight-curve, and gradient stop without hitting poles. Required documents: Vehicle with valid RC, Insurance, PUC. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: On test date.

procedure_name: Permanent Driving License & Automated Track Test
text: Biometric and photograph capture. RTO staff captures digital photograph and signature for printing on smart card. Required documents: Application slip. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

procedure_name: Permanent Driving License & Automated Track Test
section_title: Dispatch of Smart Card Driving License
text: Dispatch of Smart Card Driving License. High-security PVC Smart Card Driving License dispatched by Speed Post to residential address. Required documents: Driving License Smart Card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5–7 days.

Driving License Renewal (Online Faceless Service): Renewal of expired driving license with medical fitness certification for another 10 to 20 years. Estimated 5–7 working days. Government fee: ₹200 renewal fee + ₹200 card fee (Late fee if expired > 1 year).

text: Medical Form 1A certification. For drivers aged 40 and above, registered MBBS doctor uploads Form 1A medical fitness certificate digitally on Sarathi. Required documents: Eye test & doctor certification. Fee: ₹100 – ₹200. Processing time: 1 day.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

text: Apply on Sarathi portal. Authenticate with Aadhaar, enter existing DL number and date of birth, and confirm residential address. Required documents: Existing DL card, Aadhaar. Fee: ₹400. Processing time: 15 minutes.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

text: Pay renewal charges online. Pay fee online; no physical RTO visit needed if Aadhaar authentication is successful. Required documents: Fee payment receipt. Fee: ₹400. Processing time: Immediate.

text: RTO approval & printing. RTO licensing officer approves digital file and sends for smart card embossing. Required documents: Digital approval alert. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2–3 days.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

text: Postal delivery. Renewed driving license delivered to residential address via India Post Speed Post. Required documents: Renewed DL Card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

text: Vehicle Registration Transfer of Ownership (Form 29 & 30): Transfer of vehicle Registration Certificate (RC) to buyer upon purchase of used two-wheeler or car. Estimated 7–14 working days. Government fee: ₹300 – ₹500 transfer fee.

Execute Form 29 & 30. Buyer and seller sign Form 29 (notice of transfer) and Form 30 (application for transfer). Required documents: Form 29 & Form 30 signed, Sale agreement. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Procure vehicle fitness documents. Ensure vehicle has valid motor insurance policy, active Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate, and original RC. Required documents: Original RC smart card, Valid insurance policy, PUC certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

Submit transfer on Parivahan Vahan. Enter vehicle chassis number, buyer Aadhaar, and upload signed transfer forms. Required documents: PAN card of buyer / Form 60. Fee: ₹300 – ₹500. Processing time: 1 day.

Seller OTP consent verification. Seller receives SMS OTP on mobile registered with vehicle to approve transfer online. Required documents: Seller OTP authorization. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

section_title: Issuance of updated RC smart card
text: Issuance of updated RC smart card. RTO prints new Registration Certificate bearing buyer's name and dispatches via post. Required documents: New RC Smart Card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7 days.

procedure_name: Vehicle No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Inter-State Transfer
text: Vehicle No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Inter-State Transfer: NOC required under Form 28 to re-register a vehicle in another state or union territory. Estimated 10–15 working days. Government fee: ₹100 application fee.

procedure_name: Vehicle No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Inter-State Transfer
text: Pencil chassis print on Form 28. Take clear physical pencil impression of vehicle's metallic chassis number on 3 copies of Form 28. Required documents: 3 copies Form 28, Pencil chassis print. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 hour.

procedure_name: Vehicle No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Inter-State Transfer
text: Check traffic challan and hypothecation. Clear all pending electronic traffic challans and obtain bank loan closure NOC if previously financed. Required documents: Zero challan clearance report, Bank loan NOC. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Vehicle No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Inter-State Transfer
text: Apply online on Vahan portal. Submit destination state and destination RTO jurisdiction code where vehicle will be moved. Required documents: Original RC, Valid insurance, PUC. Fee: ₹100. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Vehicle No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Inter-State Transfer
text: Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) verification. RTO checks national stolen vehicle database to ensure vehicle is not subject to police alert. Required documents: NCRB verification clearance. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

procedure_name: Vehicle No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Inter-State Transfer
text: Collect Form 28 NOC certificate. Obtain official stamped NOC certificate valid for re-registration in destination state. Required documents: Form 28 NOC certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

procedure_name: Vehicle Loan Hypothecation Removal (HP Termination / Form 35)
text: Vehicle Loan Hypothecation Removal (HP Termination / Form 35): Removing bank finance lien from vehicle Registration Certificate after full repayment of vehicle loan. Estimated 5–7 working days. Government fee: ₹100 – ₹200 fee + new smart card charge.

procedure_name: Vehicle Loan Hypothecation Removal (HP Termination / Form 35)
text: Obtain bank loan closure kit. Collect Form 35 (two copies signed by bank officer) and Bank No Objection Certificate (NOC). Required documents: Bank Form 35, Bank NOC letter. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: From bank.

procedure_name: Vehicle Loan Hypothecation Removal (HP Termination / Form 35)
text: Submit HP cancellation on Vahan. Enter vehicle number, upload Bank NOC and signed Form 35, and pay smart card fee. Required documents: Original RC, Valid insurance, PUC. Fee: ₹200. Processing time: 15 minutes.

procedure_name: Vehicle Loan Hypothecation Removal (HP Termination / Form 35)
text: Bank electronic endorsement. Financier approves electronic loan clearance on national Vahan banking portal. Required documents: Online bank clearance. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: Vehicle Loan Hypothecation Removal (HP Termination / Form 35)
text: Submit original RC to RTO. Hand over physical RC to RTO counter or send via registered post. Required documents: Original RC smart card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Vehicle Loan Hypothecation Removal (HP Termination / Form 35)
text: Receive clean RC smart card. Receive brand new Registration Certificate showing clean ownership without bank hypothecation. Required documents: Updated RC Smart Card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

text: Duplicate Registration Certificate (Lost RC / Form 26): Issuance of replacement vehicle Registration Certificate when original card is lost, stolen, or mutilated. Estimated 7–10 working days. Government fee: ₹150 – ₹300 fee + card cost.

Lodge Police Lost Article Report (LDR). Lodge online lost property report on state police citizen portal and obtain non-traceable certificate. Required documents: Police LDR report / FIR. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.
Form 26 application. Complete Form 26 application and take pencil chassis print of vehicle. Required documents: Form 26, Pencil chassis impression. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 hour.
Apply online on Vahan portal. Upload police lost report, insurance policy, and PUC certificate. Required documents: Valid insurance, PUC copy, Aadhaar. Fee: ₹300. Processing time: 1 day.

Physical inspection at RTO. Bring vehicle to RTO premises for motor vehicle inspector to verify engine and chassis number. Required documents: Vehicle for physical verification. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: On slot date.
Dispatch of duplicate RC. RTO prints duplicate RC smart card with 'DUPLICATE' endorsement and dispatches via post. Required documents: Duplicate RC Smart Card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 days.

Commercial Vehicle Annual Fitness Certificate (FC): Mandatory annual roadworthiness testing for taxis, auto-rickshaws, buses, and commercial freight trucks. Estimated 1–2 working days. Government fee: ₹600 – ₹1,500 inspection fee.

Pre-inspection mechanical maintenance. Check speed governor calibration, retro-reflective tape visibility, emergency panic buttons, and brake pads. Required documents: Speed governor certificate, Fastag, PUC. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 1 day.

section_title: Book fitness test slot on Vahan
text: Book fitness test slot on Vahan. Pay fitness test fee online and schedule slot at automated testing station. Required documents: RC copy, Commercial road tax receipt. Fee: ₹600 – ₹1,500. Processing time: 10 minutes.

Automated lane inspection. Automated rollers and sensors inspect roller brake force, side-slip, suspension play, headlamp beam alignment, and emission. Required documents: Automated lane test log. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 hour.

Speed governor & vehicle tracking check. Inspectors verify operational status of AIS-140 GPS tracking unit and panic buttons. Required documents: AIS-140 certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 minutes.

Grant of Fitness Certificate. Receive Form 38 Certificate of Fitness and windshield validity sticker valid for 1 or 2 years. Required documents: Form 38 Fitness Certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

Contract Carriage Auto-Rickshaw & Taxi Permit: Permit authorizing commercial passenger transport within municipal city limits or regional tricity zones. Estimated 15–21 working days. Government fee: ₹1,000 – ₹3,500 permit fee.

Vehicle eligibility check. Ensure vehicle model conforms to BS-VI emission or Electric/CNG clean fuel criteria. Required documents: Vehicle invoice / RC, Valid commercial insurance. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Driver commercial badge verification. Driver must hold valid commercial driving license endorsement and PSV badge. Required documents: Commercial DL, PSV badge certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

Submit permit application on Vahan. Apply under Contract Carriage category specifying operating radius or tricity permit agreement. Required documents: Aadhaar, Fare meter calibration receipt. Fee: ₹1,000 – ₹3,500. Processing time: 1 day.
Transport authority board approval. STA board examines ceiling quota and vehicle safety compliance. Required documents: STA board approval resolution. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 days.
Issuance of Permit (Form P.Co.C.). Collect printed permit slip to be kept in vehicle with tariff card. Required documents: Contract Carriage Permit document. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

Pollution Under Control (PUC) Certificate Online: Mandatory periodic vehicle exhaust emission test (valid for 6 to 12 months) connected live to national Vahan server. Estimated 10 minutes at any fuel station. Government fee: ₹60 – ₹100 depending on fuel type (Petrol/CNG/Diesel).
jurisdiction: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

section_title: Drive vehicle to authorized PUC station
text: Drive vehicle to authorized PUC station. Visit any petrol pump PUC center with vehicle engine in warmed-up running condition. Required documents: Vehicle with physical presence. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 minutes.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

text: Exhaust gas analyzer probe insertion. Operator inserts analyzer probe into exhaust tailpipe to measure CO, Hydrocarbons (HC), and Smoke Opacity. Required documents: Live sensor readout. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 minutes.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

text: Live webcam vehicle photo capture. Webcam captures registration number plate photo while vehicle is connected to testing software. Required documents: Webcam timestamp photo. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 minute.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

text: Live upload to central Vahan database. Test software uploads emission values directly to central Parivahan server without manual tampering. Required documents: Server upload confirmation. Fee: ₹60 – ₹100. Processing time: Instant.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

text: Collect printed PUC certificate. Receive printed certificate containing QR code and validity period (6 months for older BS, 1 year for BS-VI). Required documents: PUC Certificate printout. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

text: Register on Parivahan Fancy Number Portal. Create bidder profile with Aadhaar and deposit non-refundable registration fee. Required documents: Aadhaar, PAN. Fee: ₹1,000. Processing time: 10 minutes.

procedure_name: VIP / Fancy Vehicle Registration Number E-Auction
text: Select desired registration number. Search number availability in the active newly opened registration series. Required documents: Number selection. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 minutes.

procedure_name: VIP / Fancy Vehicle Registration Number E-Auction
text: Participate in live e-auction bidding. Place incremental bids during active 48-hour auction bidding period. Required documents: Online bidding screen. Fee: Bid amounts. Processing time: 2 days.

procedure_name: VIP / Fancy Vehicle Registration Number E-Auction
text: Collect Allotment Letter. Highest bidder pays balance within 5 days and receives official Number Allotment Letter for vehicle registration. Required documents: Allotment Order. Fee: Winning bid. Processing time: Same day.

procedure_name: Registered Vehicle Scrappage Certificate of Deposit (CoD)
text: Registered Vehicle Scrappage Certificate of Deposit (CoD): Environment-friendly scrappage of end-of-life vehicles (15+ years) granting motor tax rebates on new car purchase. Estimated 3–5 working days. Government fee: Scrap metal value paid to owner + up to 25% road tax rebate.

procedure_name: Registered Vehicle Scrappage Certificate of Deposit (CoD)
text: Identify authorized RVSF facility. Select government-registered authorized vehicle scrap center on national portal. Required documents: Vehicle location. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 minutes.

procedure_name: Registered Vehicle Scrappage Certificate of Deposit (CoD)
text: Handover vehicle with original documents. Provide vehicle along with original RC, insurance, and owner identity proofs. Required documents: Original RC, Owner Aadhaar & PAN, Bank details. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

procedure_name: Registered Vehicle Scrappage Certificate of Deposit (CoD)
text: Physical inspection & valuation. Scrappage center weighs vehicle and evaluates scrap metal and component salvage value. Required documents: Scrap valuation agreement. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 hours.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

procedure_name: Registered Vehicle Scrappage Certificate of Deposit (CoD)
text: Scientific dismantling and destruction. Vehicle undergoes eco-friendly fluid draining, hazardous material depollution, and chassis shredding. Required documents: Destruction video log. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

procedure_name: Registered Vehicle Scrappage Certificate of Deposit (CoD)
text: Issuance of Certificate of Deposit (CoD). Owner receives digital Certificate of Deposit conferring up to 25% concession on new vehicle road tax. Required documents: Certificate of Deposit (CoD) PDF. Fee: Payout credited to owner. Processing time: Same day.

text: Widow & Destitute Women Pension Scheme: Monthly financial pension assistance to widows and destitute women with dependent children. Estimated 20–30 working days. Government fee: ₹0 (Free Scheme).
Procure husband's death certificate. Obtain official government death certificate of late spouse. Required documents: Husband's death certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.
Self-declaration of non-remarriage. Provide affidavit affirming that the applicant has not remarried. Required documents: Notarized affidavit. Fee: ₹50. Processing time: 1 day.

Submit online application. Submit application on state social security portal with family income proof and children birth certificates. Required documents: Income certificate, Children school/birth certificates, Aadhaar. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.
Social welfare committee scrutiny. District social welfare officer reviews records and verifies non-employment status. Required documents: Verification report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 14 days.

Monthly pension disbursement. Receive pension sanction book and monthly direct benefit transfer into savings account. Required documents: Pension Sanction ID. Fee: Monthly transfer. Processing time: Immediate post-approval.

department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Municipal Corporation
text: PM Awas Yojana (PMAY-Urban) Housing Subsidy: Credit Linked Subsidy (CLSS) of up to ₹2.67 Lakh or affordable housing allotment for homeless EWS/LIG families. Estimated 30–60 working days. Government fee: ₹0 application fee.

department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Municipal Corporation
text: Verify EWS/LIG income category. Annual family income up to ₹3 Lakh for Economically Weaker Section (EWS); up to ₹6 Lakh for Low Income Group (LIG). Required documents: Income certificate, Bank statement. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Municipal Corporation
text: Pucca house non-ownership affidavit. Submit affidavit declaring that the beneficiary family does not own a pucca house anywhere in India. Required documents: Notarized PMAY affidavit. Fee: ₹100. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Municipal Corporation
text: Register on PMAY-MIS portal. Submit Aadhaar numbers of all family members, existing house rent proof, and bank IFSC details. Required documents: Family Aadhaar cards, Rent agreement. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Municipal Corporation
text: Geo-tagging and civic survey. Municipal survey team visits current dwelling to conduct geo-tagged photo verification. Required documents: Geo-tagged mobile survey record. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 days.

department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Municipal Corporation
text: Interest subsidy credit / Flat allotment. Central government releases interest subsidy directly to home loan bank account or allocates municipal housing unit. Required documents: PMAY Sanction Letter. Fee: Up to ₹2.67 Lakh subsidy. Processing time: Post-scrutiny.

procedure_name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Golden Health Card
text: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Golden Health Card: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year at empaneled hospitals. Estimated Instant to 24 hours. Government fee: ₹0 (Completely Free of Cost).
jurisdiction: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

procedure_name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Golden Health Card
text: Check eligibility on portal. Search name or ration card number on National Beneficiary portal (SECC list or state NFSA database). Required documents: Ration card number, Aadhaar number. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 2 minutes.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

procedure_name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Golden Health Card
text: Aadhaar e-KYC authentication. Perform face-authentication via mobile app or biometric scan at Ayushman Mitra hospital kiosk. Required documents: Aadhaar linked mobile OTP / Biometrics. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 minutes.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

procedure_name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Golden Health Card
text: Family member matching. Verify relationships and link dependent family members. Required documents: Ration card / Family register. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 minutes.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

procedure_name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Golden Health Card
text: Instant Ayushman Card download. Download official PVC Ayushman Bharat card with PM-JAY unique ID. Required documents: Ayushman Card PDF. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

procedure_name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Golden Health Card
text: Cashless hospital admission. Show card at any empanelled public or private hospital for cashless treatment up to ₹5,00,000. Required documents: Ayushman Card. Fee: Cashless treatment. Processing time: Immediate.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

procedure_name: PM SVANidhi Micro-Credit Loan for Street Vendors
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & SIDBI
text: PM SVANidhi Micro-Credit Loan for Street Vendors: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000, ₹20,000, and ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy for street vendors. Estimated 7–10 working days. Government fee: ₹0 application fee; low subsidized interest.

procedure_name: PM SVANidhi Micro-Credit Loan for Street Vendors
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & SIDBI
text: Confirm street vending credentials. Vendor must hold Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from urban local body. Required documents: Vending certificate / LoR. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

procedure_name: PM SVANidhi Micro-Credit Loan for Street Vendors
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & SIDBI
text: Apply on PM SVANidhi portal. Select preferred lending bank, input mobile number linked to Aadhaar, and loan amount tier. Required documents: Aadhaar, Bank passbook. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 minutes.

procedure_name: PM SVANidhi Micro-Credit Loan for Street Vendors
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & SIDBI
text: Bank digital appraisal. Bank verifies credit history; no physical collateral or guarantor required. Required documents: Credit verification check. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3–5 days.

procedure_name: PM SVANidhi Micro-Credit Loan for Street Vendors
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & SIDBI
text: Loan disbursement to savings account. Loan credited directly into bank account; vendor receives digital QR code for digital transaction cashbacks. Required documents: Bank credit alert. Fee: ₹10,000 – ₹50,000. Processing time: Immediate.

procedure_name: PM SVANidhi Micro-Credit Loan for Street Vendors
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & SIDBI
text: 7% interest subsidy payout. Interest subsidy of 7% credited quarterly into bank account upon timely monthly repayment. Required documents: Subsidy credit SMS. Fee: 7% subsidy. Processing time: Quarterly.

procedure_name: Beti Bachao / Ladli Kanya Financial Incentive Scheme
text: Beti Bachao / Ladli Kanya Financial Incentive Scheme: Fixed deposit financial aid deposited in the name of girl children at birth, school admissions, and upon turning 18. Estimated 15–20 working days. Government fee: ₹0 (Free State Scheme).

procedure_name: Beti Bachao / Ladli Kanya Financial Incentive Scheme
section_title: Registration at birth of girl child
text: Registration at birth of girl child. Apply within 1 year of girl child birth at government hospital or Anganwadi center. Required documents: Birth certificate of girl child, Hospital discharge slip. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Beti Bachao / Ladli Kanya Financial Incentive Scheme
text: Parent residency & family income check. Parents must have resided in state for 3+ years with annual income under prescribed limit. Required documents: Income certificate, Parent domicile/voter ID. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Beti Bachao / Ladli Kanya Financial Incentive Scheme
text: Submit application on WCD portal. Upload child photograph, mother bank details, and immunization card. Required documents: Child immunization card, Mother Aadhaar & bank passbook. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Beti Bachao / Ladli Kanya Financial Incentive Scheme
section_title: Issuance of National Savings Certificate / FD
text: Issuance of National Savings Certificate / FD. Government purchases fixed deposit in the girl child's name with phased payouts at 6th, 9th, and 12th class milestones. Required documents: Sanction certificate of investment. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 days.

procedure_name: Beti Bachao / Ladli Kanya Financial Incentive Scheme
text: Maturity payout on turning 18. Full maturity amount released when the girl passes class 12 and attains age 18 as an unmarried citizen. Required documents: Class 12 marksheet, Age certificate. Fee: Maturity benefit. Processing time: At age 18.

department: Department of Social Security and Empowerment
text: Divyangjan Disability Monthly Pension: Monthly pension assistance to citizens with 40% or higher certified physical or intellectual disabilities. Estimated 20–30 working days. Government fee: ₹0 (Free Welfare Scheme).

department: Department of Social Security and Empowerment
text: Obtain 40%+ Disability Certificate / UDID. Produce digital UDID card or disability certificate issued by government medical board. Required documents: UDID Card / Disability Certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: From medical board.

department: Department of Social Security and Empowerment
text: Income declaration. Applicant family income must fall below state specified ceiling. Required documents: Income certificate from Tehsildar. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Department of Social Security and Empowerment
section_title: Submit application online or at SDM office
text: Submit application online or at SDM office. Submit bank account details linked to Aadhaar for automated monthly payments. Required documents: Aadhaar, Bank passbook copy. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Department of Social Security and Empowerment
text: District disability officer review. Committee verifies non-receipt of competing pensions. Required documents: Scrutiny register. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 14 days.

department: Department of Social Security and Empowerment
text: Monthly pension disbursement. Receive recurring pension of ₹1,500 – ₹3,000 credited to bank account every month. Required documents: Monthly pension credit SMS. Fee: Monthly assistance. Processing time: Monthly.

procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) Maternity Benefit
text: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) Maternity Benefit: Direct cash benefit of ₹5,000 in two installments for pregnant women and lactating mothers for first and second child. Estimated 15–20 working days per installment. Government fee: ₹0 (Free Cash Maternity Benefit).

procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) Maternity Benefit
section_title: Register pregnancy at Anganwadi / Health Center
text: Register pregnancy at Anganwadi / Health Center. Register pregnancy within 150 days of Last Menstrual Period (LMP) and obtain MCP card. Required documents: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) Maternity Benefit
text: Submit Form 1A on PMMVY portal. Submit MCP card showing at least one antenatal checkup (ANC) for first installment (₹3,000). Required documents: Aadhaar of mother and husband, Mother bank passbook. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) Maternity Benefit
text: Undergo child birth registration & vaccinations. Register child birth and complete primary vaccination cycle (BCG, OPV, DPT, Hepatitis B). Required documents: Child birth certificate, Immunization record in MCP card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: After birth.

procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) Maternity Benefit
text: Submit Form 1B for second installment. Submit vaccination completion proof to claim second installment (₹2,000). Required documents: Vaccination certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) Maternity Benefit
section_title: Direct DBT transfer to mother account
text: Direct DBT transfer to mother account. Funds transferred directly to woman's Aadhaar-seeded bank account. Required documents: DBT credit alert. Fee: ₹5,000 total. Processing time: Direct credit.

Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students: 100% tuition fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowance for post-secondary and college students. Estimated 30–45 working days. Government fee: ₹0 application fee.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Social Justice & State Governments

text: College admission verification. Secure admission in recognized college, university, or polytechnic institution. Required documents: College fee receipt, Admission allotment letter. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: At admission.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Social Justice & State Governments

section_title: Submit application on National Scholarship Portal
text: Submit application on National Scholarship Portal. Register using OTR (One Time Registration) via Aadhaar Face RD app. Required documents: Aadhaar number, Mobile. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 minutes.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Social Justice & State Governments

text: Upload scholarship documents. Upload caste certificate, parent income certificate (under ₹2.5 Lakh), and previous class marksheet. Required documents: Caste certificate, Income certificate, Previous class marksheet. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Social Justice & State Governments

text: College level verification (Level 1). College scholarship nodal officer inspects attendance and verifies course fee structure online. Required documents: Institute online approval. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 7 days.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Social Justice & State Governments

text: District social welfare officer approval (Level 2). State department approves scholarship and releases DBT payments directly to student account and college. Required documents: PFMS credit alert. Fee: Full tuition + allowance. Processing time: Direct credit.
jurisdiction: Ministry of Social Justice & State Governments

department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
text: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi (Farmer Financial Benefit): Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 to all landholding farmer families. Estimated 15–20 working days. Government fee: ₹0 (Free Scheme).

department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
text: Farmer land record verification. Ensure land ownership record (Jamabandi / RoR / Khatauni) is updated in the farmer's name. Required documents: Land ownership title document (Jamabandi). Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
text: Farmer registration on PM-Kisan portal. Input Aadhaar, mobile number, land plot survey number, and bank account details. Required documents: Aadhaar card, Bank passbook. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 minutes.

department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
text: Aadhaar e-KYC authentication. Complete mandatory biometric or face e-KYC on PM-Kisan mobile app. Required documents: Aadhaar OTP / Face e-KYC. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 minutes.

department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
text: State revenue department validation. State agriculture/revenue nodal officer validates land records against state land registry. Required documents: State approval flag. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 days.

department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
text: Four-monthly DBT installment credit. Receive ₹2,000 direct credit every four months (April-July, August-November, December-March). Required documents: PM-Kisan SMS notification. Fee: ₹2,000 per installment. Processing time: Tri-annually.

Antyeshti Sahayata / Financial Funeral Assistance: Immediate one-time financial grant of ₹5,000 to ₹10,000 to assist indigent families with final funeral rites. Estimated 24–48 hours emergency response. Government fee: ₹0 (Free Emergency Grant).
Obtain cremation ground receipt. Secure official slip from municipal cremation ground or burial ground. Required documents: Cremation receipt. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Immediate.

Submit BPL / EWS credentials. Submit deceased death certificate, BPL ration card or income certificate, and applicant bank details. Required documents: BPL ration card, Applicant Aadhaar & passbook. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.
Approval by Municipal Ward Officer. Zonal municipal officer or Tehsildar sanctions immediate assistance grant. Required documents: Sanction voucher. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 24 hours.
Direct emergency bank disbursement. Grant credited directly into savings account of nearest surviving kin. Required documents: Bank credit SMS. Fee: ₹5,000 – ₹10,000. Processing time: 24–48 hours.

e-Shram Card for Unorganized Workers: National database registration card providing ₹2 Lakh accidental insurance cover under PMSBY and social welfare eligibility. Estimated Instant download. Government fee: ₹0 (Completely Free of Cost).

Check eligibility criteria. Applicant must be an unorganized worker (construction, domestic, driver, agriculture) aged between 16 and 59, not in EPFO/ESIC. Required documents: Aadhaar card, Active mobile linked with Aadhaar. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 minutes.

Register on e-Shram portal. Authenticate via Aadhaar OTP, select primary occupation and sub-occupation from national skill list. Required documents: Bank account number & IFSC. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 minutes.

Enter permanent address & nominee details. Add emergency nominee name and relationship for accidental insurance benefits. Required documents: Nominee Aadhaar details. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 5 minutes.

Download 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN) Card. Instantly download digital PVC e-Shram card with photo and permanent UAN number. Required documents: e-Shram Card PDF with UAN. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Instant.

department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
text: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) Guaranteed Pension: Government-backed guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month starting at age 60. Estimated Same day enrollment at bank. Government fee: Monthly auto-debit contribution based on joining age (₹42 – ₹1,454/month).

department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
text: Eligibility check (Age 18–40). Applicant must be an Indian citizen aged between 18 and 40 years, with an active bank savings account. Required documents: Savings bank passbook, Aadhaar card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
text: Choose desired pension tier. Select monthly pension amount (₹1,000 to ₹5,000) and frequency of contribution (monthly/quarterly). Required documents: Nominee particulars. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 10 minutes.

department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
text: Submit auto-debit authorization. Apply via internet banking or submit APY registration form to bank branch authorizing auto-debit. Required documents: Signed auto-debit mandate. Fee: Monthly contribution. Processing time: Same day.

department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
text: PRAN generation and acknowledgement. Receive permanent APY PRAN number and digital subscriber registration slip. Required documents: APY PRAN card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Instant.

department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
text: Guaranteed pension commencement at age 60. Lifelong monthly pension credited on the first of every month post age 60, followed by return of corpus to nominee. Required documents: Pension credit advice. Fee: Guaranteed pension. Processing time: At age 60.

procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) Free LPG Connection
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
text: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) Free LPG Connection: Deposit-free LPG cylinder connection, free stove, and initial refill for adult women from poor households. Estimated 7–10 working days. Government fee: ₹0 (100% Free Government Connection).

procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) Free LPG Connection
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
text: Eligibility check for female adult. Applicant must be an adult woman belonging to BPL/SC/ST/Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana household. Required documents: BPL ration card, Woman Aadhaar card. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day.

procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) Free LPG Connection
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
section_title: Submit application at nearest gas distributor
text: Submit application at nearest gas distributor. Apply on PMUY portal or submit form at nearest Indane, Bharat Gas, or HP Gas dealership. Required documents: Bank passbook showing Aadhaar seeding, Proof of address. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) Free LPG Connection
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
text: De-duplication check by OMC. Oil Marketing Company cross-verifies database to ensure household has no existing LPG connection. Required documents: National LPG database verification. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 3 days.

procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) Free LPG Connection
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
text: Collection of cylinder and stove. Dealer supplies free 14.2 kg LPG cylinder, regulator, safety rubber hose, and domestic gas stove. Required documents: Ujjwala connection passbook. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: Same day at delivery.

procedure_name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) Free LPG Connection
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
text: Targeted cylinder subsidy. Receive ongoing government targeted subsidy credited directly to bank account on future refills. Required documents: Subsidy credit SMS. Fee: Direct subsidy. Processing time: On refill.

National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS): One-time lump sum grant of ₹20,000 to below-poverty-line families upon the death of the primary breadwinner. Estimated 30–45 working days. Government fee: ₹0 (Free Welfare Grant).

Confirm breadwinner criteria. Deceased must have been primary breadwinner aged between 18 and 59 at time of death. Required documents: Death certificate of breadwinner, Age proof of deceased. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.
Submit BPL proof. Produce verified BPL ration card or family annual income certificate below poverty threshold. Required documents: BPL card, Income certificate. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

section_title: Submit application on state social security portal
text: Submit application on state social security portal. Submit surviving spouse/head Aadhaar, post-mortem report (if accidental), and bank passbook. Required documents: Surviving spouse bank passbook. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.
Sub-Divisional Magistrate verification. Revenue officer conducts field verification of dependents. Required documents: Enquiry report. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 15 days.
Lump-sum DBT credit. One-time assistance of ₹20,000 credited directly to bank account of surviving spouse. Required documents: PFMS credit alert. Fee: ₹20,000 grant. Processing time: Direct credit.

procedure_name: Stand-Up India Loan for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Stand-Up India Loan for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading sector. Estimated 30–45 working days. Government fee: ₹0 application fee; lowest commercial interest rate.

procedure_name: Stand-Up India Loan for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Greenfield business project report. Prepare detailed project report (DPR) showing proposed business, machinery cost, and financial viability. Required documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR), Quotations for machinery. Fee: Varies. Processing time: 7 days.

procedure_name: Stand-Up India Loan for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Verify SC/ST or Woman category. Borrower must be a woman or SC/ST entrepreneur holding at least 51% shareholding in enterprise. Required documents: Caste certificate (if SC/ST), PAN & Aadhaar. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Stand-Up India Loan for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Apply on Stand-Up Mitra portal. Submit loan application selecting preferred scheduled commercial bank branch. Required documents: Audited balance sheets (if existing) / Net worth statements. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 1 day.

procedure_name: Stand-Up India Loan for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Bank appraisal and credit evaluation. Bank manager reviews collateral/Credit Guarantee Scheme (CGFSI) and evaluates business model. Required documents: Bank sanction appraisal memo. Fee: ₹0. Processing time: 20 days.

procedure_name: Stand-Up India Loan for SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
text: Loan sanction and disbursement. Receive composite loan sanction (term loan + working capital) between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore. Required documents: Loan sanction letter and disbursement. Fee: ₹10L – ₹1Cr loan. Processing time: Post-documentation.
